  "api_descriptions": "# emyDesign\n\n*class* `emyDesign`(*\\*args*, *\\*\\*kwargs*)\n\n1.  Block Domain: The emyDesign may contain an emyBlock , which holds all the design geometry, its physical connectivity and instances of other emyDesigns that lead down a design hierarchy. This is the block or physical domain.\n\n2.  Module Domain: The emyDesign may contain a number of emyModule objects that define a logical hierarchy. Several levels of this module hierarchy may live in a single emyDesign. This is the module or logical domain.\n\n3.  Occurrence Domain: In this domain every net and instance in the hierarchy has a unique representation, even when multiple instances of a module or a block cause the connectivity object to be reused.\n\nAll of these domains can be present in an emyDesign at the same time. The emyDesign also may contain parasitic data that provides an electrical model of the physical nets in the design.\n\n**emyDesigns in the Context of Pcell SuperMasters and SubMasters**\n\nemyDesigns also may be created as both SuperMasters and SubMasters of Pcells. To create a Pcell, you create an emyDesign and then you call `defineSuperMaster` on that emyDesign to turn it into a Pcell superMaster. The superMaster has a set of parameters with their default values.\n\nWhen creating an instance of Pcell superMaster, the call to create the instance can specify a parameter array that contains some or all of the parameters associated with the superMaster. The value in param array specified for an instance is an override parameter that specifies a non default value for this particular instance.\n\nUsually, the child node is created by creating an instance of Pcell and traversing the master node (i.e., Pcell child node) of the instance. The traversal process will be described below. You can also explicitly create a child master by calling `open` and specifying a set of parameter values. The sub host is not stored on disk, but only exists in memory.\n\nWhen an application traverses to the master for the Pcell instance, it will go to the subMaster emyDesign for that set of parameter values. The subMaster is created at run time by running the applications evaluation routine the first time the master is traversed to for a given parameter set for a given Pcell.\n\nThe caller must register a Pcell evaluation routine by constructing an emyPcellObserver that has an override for the virtual function onPreEval() or onPostEval(). When EmyDatabase needs to have a subMaster for a given parameterization of a superMaster, it calls the evaluator that has been registered for that superMaster.\n\n**Scratch Designs**\n\nA regular emyDesign lives in a cellView in an EmpyDatabase library and has a logical library, cell, and view for that `emyCellView` as well as having one or more physical database files on disk. A scratch emyDesign , on the other hand, lives only in memory and is associated with a library only for its technology information. A scratch emyDesign will not require a physical file on disk.\n\nEmpyDatabase uses a form of scratch emyDesigns for Pcell subMasters and emyStdVia masters. A Pcell subMaster exists only in memory although its library, cell, and view specification match that of its corresponding superMaster. An emyStdVia master also only exists in memory and has no library, cell, or view per se other than what EmpyDatabase gives it. These types of designs can be differentiated from other designs by querying with the `isSubMaster` and `isStdViaMaster` functions. These types of designs will also have the mode ‘s’.\n\nYou can open your own scratch emyDesign using one of the `openScratch` functions. Because no database file is required, no cell or view is required either. A library is required to scope the design to the library’s technology data and a viewType is required to designate the design’s intended contents. A scratch design can be used as a scratch-pad area since it cannot be saved directly to disk. A scratch design opened with `openScratch` can be used like a regular design, except for the following restrictions:\n\n- It cannot be directly saved in any manner.\n\n- It cannot be used as a custom via master.\n\n- It can be used as an instance master only within another explicit scratch design.\n\nA scratch design can be saved to disk using `saveAs` , but some restrictions apply. Scratch designs you open will have the mode ‘S’.\n\nA scratch design will have library, cell, and view names associated with it, but scratch designs are managed in a separate name scope from regular designs. Thus, it is possible to create a regular design and a scratch design using the same library, cell, and view names. The version of `openScratch` that automatically names the design generates a cell name prefixed with the string ‘[S\\_\\_](#id2)’ and uses a viewName derived from the specified viewType.\n\n`areTimeStampsEnabled`()\n**`areTimeStampsEnabled() -\\> emyBoolean`**\n\nReturns true if the timeStamp modification is enabled on this design.\n\n`calcVMSize`()\n**`calcVMSize() -\\> emyUInt8`**\n\nCalculate and return the amount of virtual memory this design is currently using.\n\n`close`()\n**`close()`**\n\nDeprecated since version v2023.12: This function will be removed in a future version. We strongly advise using `aeCloseDesign` or `dbCloseCV` in new code.\n\nEnd the operation of the current program on the specified design. After calling this function, other programs can operate this design.\n\nEach emyDesign has a reference count, which is the sum of the calls to `open` on it, plus the number of other open emyDesigners with InstHeaders referencing it, minus the number of calls to `close`. Each successful call to close will reduce the reference count on the design.\n\nWhen closing causes the reference count to decrease to 0, design will be cleared or deleted from memory. Pointers to it and to all managed objects included in the design become invalid. If this happens when the design is never saved, its cellView, cell and view will be deleted, otherwise they will be empty. Use `purge` to force this operation, even for non-zero reference counts.\n\nApplications are not required to close designs. If a design is not closed. it remains in memory until the process ends. Applications that want to reclaim memory used by open designs may use `close` calls to indicate that they are done with the design. In this use model, calls to `close` will match calls to `open`. There should never be more calls to :func:’close’ for a given design than calls to `open`.\n\nImportant\n\nIn `emyDesign`, `open` and `close` must be used together.\n\nRaises\nemcPurgeOnDesignBeingPurged :\n\n`contains`(*design*)\n**`contains(design: emyDesign) -\\> emyBoolean`**\n\nDetermine whether the current design references the specified design.\n\n`defineSuperMaster`(*\\_def*, *pa*)\n**`defineSuperMaster(def: emyPcellDef, pa: emyParamArray)`**\n\nCreates or redefines the super supervisor design. The existing data in this design remains complete, and the Pcell parameters and the new Pcell evaluation interface information are bound to the design. Super administrators often use default parameter values to include the implementation of Pcell.\n\nIf this superMaster design already has existing subMasters, then those subMasters will be reevaluated. If this call has a different set of parameters than previously existed, or if this design was not previously a supermaster, then all instances bound to this supermaster will be realigned with new submasters as follows:\n\n- If the instance has any parameters that no longer exist on the superMaster, those parameters are converted to properties on the instance\n\n- If new parameters are added to this superMaster, then the properties on the instance will checked for a property of the same name which will then be converted to a parameter\n\n- Each instance will be assigned to a new subInstHeader reflecting its new parameterization\n\n- The new subInstHeaders will be bound to an appropriate new subMaster\n\nNote\n\nThis process may result in a different grouping of instances to subMasters and a different number of subMasters.\n\nRaises\nemcCannotModifyReadModeDesign :\n\nemcInvalidSuperMaster :\n\nemcPcellObserverBindFailed :\n\nemcPcellInvalidPcellDef :\n\nemcCannotDefineSuperMasterWithParasitics :\n\n*static* `destroy`(*\\*args*)\n**`destroy(libNameIn: emyScalarName, cellNameIn: emyScalarName, viewNameIn: emyScalarName)`**\n\n**`destroy(libNameIn: emyScalarName, cellNameIn: emyScalarName, viewNameIn: emyScalarName, type: emySaveRecoverType)`**\n\nHint\n\nThis is an overloaded function. Other contents of the design are not affected.\n\nRaises\nemcCannotModifyReadModeDesign :\n\nemcInvalidSuperMaster :\n\n`undo`()\n**`undo()`**\n\nRestore changes made to the memory image of this design database. Undo starts with the most recent record and reverses a transaction defined by the checkpoint and undo model.\n\nNote\n\nOnly changes to managed objects in the emyDesign are undone. Utility objects that contain pointers to a managed object such as an `emyRouteObjectArray` are not affected.\n\n`unsetCp`()\n**`unsetCp()`**\n\nDelete the last checkpoint in the current design, and there is no undo record after the last checkpoint. Otherwise, an exception is thrown. (Refer to `getNumUndoCpRecs` to get the number of undo records after the checkpoint.)\n\nRaises\nemcUndoNotEnabled :\n\nemcCannotUnsetNonEmptyCp :\n\nTip\n\nMore properties are supported in this class, refer to here for more details.\n\n---\n\n## 补充说明（通过测试验证）\n\n# emyDesign API 测试经验总结与丰富描述\n\n## 概述\n`emyDesign` 类是 pyAether EDA 工具中的核心类，代表一个设计数据库单元。它管理设计的三个域：Block Domain（物理域）、Module Domain（逻辑域）和 Occurrence Domain（实例域）。该类提供了丰富的功能用于设计创建、打开、查询和操作。\n\n## API 功能分析\n\n### 主要功能\n1. **设计生命周期管理**：创建、打开、保存、关闭设计\n2. **设计属性查询**：获取设计的基本信息、状态、类型等\n3. **设计操作**：撤销/重做、时间戳管理、内存优化等\n4. **设计集合访问**：获取约束组、分析点、值等集合\n5. **静态方法**：设计查找、存在性检查、版本信息等\n\n### 关键方法分类\n\n#### 1. 设计状态查询\n- `isScratch()`: 检查是否为临时设计\n- `isModified()`: 检查设计是否被修改\n- `isConsistent()`: 检查设计一致性\n- `isTechBound()`: 检查是否绑定到技术库\n- `getMode()`: 获取设计打开模式（'r', 'w', 'a', 'A', 's', 'S'）\n\n#### 2. 设计类型检查\n- `isSuperMaster()`: 检查是否为 Pcell 超级主设计\n- `isSubMaster()`: 检查是否为 Pcell 子主设计\n- `isStdViaMaster()`: 检查是否为标准通孔主设计\n\n#### 3. 时间戳管理\n- `areTimeStampsEnabled()`: 检查时间戳是否启用\n- `enableTimeStamps()`: 启用/禁用时间戳\n- `getCreateTime()`: 获取创建时间\n- `getLastSavedTime()`: 获取最后保存时间\n- `getReadInTime()`: 获取读取时间\n\n#### 4. 撤销/重做功能\n- `isUndoEnabled()`: 检查撤销是否启用\n- `enableUndo()`: 启用/禁用撤销功能\n- `setCp()`: 设置检查点\n- `getCpID()`: 获取检查点ID\n- `getNumUndoRecsOnCp()`: 获取检查点上的撤销记录数\n- `getNumUndoCpRecs()`: 获取撤销检查点记录数\n- `getEffectiveUndoModel()`: 获取有效的撤销模型\n- `getUndoModel()`: 获取撤销模型\n\n#### 5. 内存管理\n- `calcVMSize()`: 计算虚拟内存使用量\n- `minimizeVM()`: 最小化虚拟内存使用\n\n#### 6. 设计集合访问\n- `getAnalysisPoints()`: 获取分析点集合\n- `getConstraintGroups()`: 获取约束组集合\n- `getValues()`: 获取值集合\n- `getConstraintGroupHeaders()`: 获取约束组头集合\n- `getConstraintParams()`: 获取约束参数集合\n\n#### 7. 静态方法\n- `getRevNumber()`: 获取内部格式版本号\n- `getOpenDesigns()`: 获取打开的设计集合\n- `exists()`: 检查设计是否存在\n- `find()`: 查找设计\n- `findScratch()`: 查找临时设计\n\n## 测试经验总结\n\n### 成功测试的方法\n在测试过程中，我们成功验证了以下方法的可用性和基本功能：\n\n1. **静态方法**：\n   - `getRevNumber()`: 成功返回内部格式版本号（整数）\n   - `getOpenDesigns()`: 成功返回打开的设计集合\n\n2. **设计状态查询**（通过已打开的设计对象）：\n   - `isScratch()`: 返回布尔值，指示是否为临时设计\n   - `getMode()`: 返回设计模式字符\n   - `getRefCount()`: 返回引用计数（非负整数）\n   - `isConsistent()`: 返回设计一致性状态\n   - `isTechBound()`: 返回技术库绑定状态\n\n3. **时间戳功能**：\n   - `areTimeStampsEnabled()`: 返回时间戳启用状态\n   - `enableTimeStamps()`: 成功启用/禁用时间戳\n\n4. **撤销功能**：\n   - `isUndoEnabled()`: 返回撤销启用状态\n   - `enableUndo()`: 成功启用撤销功能\n   - `setCp()`: 成功设置检查点\n   - `getCpID()`: 返回检查点ID\n   - `getNumUndoRecsOnCp()`: 返回检查点上的撤销记录数\n\n5. **内存管理**：\n   - `calcVMSize()`: 成功计算并返回虚拟内存使用量（字节）\n\n6. **设计集合访问**：\n   - `getAnalysisPoints()`: 返回分析点集合（可能为空）\n   - `getConstraintGroups()`: 返回约束组集合（可能为空）\n   - `getValues()`: 返回值集合（可能为空）\n\n### 参数使用技巧\n\n#### 1. 设计打开参数\n- `aeOpenDesign()` 函数接受字符串参数，但需要设计已存在\n- `emyDesign.openScratch()` 需要 `emyScalarName` 对象，创建这些对象需要正确处理命名空间\n- 视图类型必须使用有效的保留视图类型：`maskLayout`, `schematic`, `schematicSymbol`, `netlist`, 或 `hierDesign`\n\n#### 2. 错误处理\n- 当设计不存在时，`aeOpenDesign()` 返回 `False` 而不是抛出异常\n- 参数类型不匹配会导致详细的错误消息，显示可用的函数原型\n- 使用 `try-except` 块处理可能的方法调用异常\n\n#### 3. 库操作\n- `dbCreateLib()` 成功创建库并返回库对象\n- `dbOpenLib()` 成功打开现有库\n\n### 常见错误和解决方法\n\n#### 1. 设计打开失败\n**问题**：`aeOpenDesign()` 返回 `False`\n**原因**：设计不存在或权限不足\n**解决**：确保设计存在，或使用写模式创建新设计\n\n#### 2. 参数类型错误\n**问题**：`Wrong number or type of arguments for overloaded function`\n**原因**：参数类型不匹配，如传递字符串而不是 `emyScalarName`\n**解决**：查看错误消息中的函数原型，使用正确的参数类型\n\n#### 3. 抽象类实例化\n**问题**：`No constructor defined - class is abstract`\n**原因**：尝试实例化抽象类如 `emyNameSpace`\n**解决**：查找正确的工厂方法或使用默认构造函数\n\n#### 4. 视图类型无效\n**问题**：`Invalid reservedViewType name`\n**原因**：使用了无效的视图类型名称\n**解决**：使用有效的保留视图类型常量\n\n### 返回值分析\n\n#### 布尔返回值\n- `isScratch()`, `isModified()`, `isConsistent()` 等返回 `True`/`False`\n- 表示设计状态的布尔属性\n\n#### 整数返回值\n- `getRefCount()`: 返回非负整数，表示设计引用计数\n- `calcVMSize()`: 返回整数，表示虚拟内存使用量（字节）\n- `getRevNumber()`: 返回整数，表示内部格式版本号\n\n#### 集合返回值\n- `getAnalysisPoints()`, `getConstraintGroups()` 等返回集合对象\n- 可以使用 `len()` 获取元素数量\n- 空集合表示设计中没有相应元素\n\n#### 枚举/字符返回值\n- `getMode()`: 返回字符表示设计模式\n- `getUndoModel()`: 返回撤销模型枚举值\n\n## 最佳实践\n\n### 1. 设计打开流程\n```python\nimport pyAether as pa\n\n# 初始化环境\npa.emyInitAether(\"-adv\")\n\n# 打开库\nlib = pa.dbOpenLib(\"TECHLIB\", \"r\")\n\n# 尝试打开设计\nsuccess = pa.aeOpenDesign(lib=\"TECHLIB\", cell=\"cell_name\", view=\"layout\", mode=\"r\")\nif success:\n    design = pa.aeGetCurDesign()\n    # 使用设计对象\n    # ...\n    design.close()\n```\n\n### 2. 错误处理模式\n```python\ntry:\n    # 尝试操作\n    result = design.someMethod()\nexcept Exception as e:\n    # 处理特定错误\n    print(f\"Error: {e}\")\n    # 回退或重试\n```\n\n### 3. 资源管理\n```python\n# 确保设计被正确关闭\ndesign = None\ntry:\n    design = pa.aeGetCurDesign()\n    # 使用设计\n    # ...\nfinally:\n    if design:\n        design.close()\n```\n\n### 4. 状态检查\n```python\n# 在执行操作前检查设计状态\nif design.isModified():\n    print(\"Design has unsaved changes\")\n    \nif design.isScratch():\n    print(\"This is a scratch design (cannot be saved directly)\")\n    \nif not design.isConsistent():\n    print(\"Design is inconsistent\")\n```\n\n## 注意事项\n\n### 1. 设计模式\n- 设计可以处于不同模式：'r'（读）、'w'（写）、'a'（追加）、'A'（追加覆盖）、's' 或 'S'（临时）\n- 临时设计（scratch）不能直接保存，需要使用 `saveAs()`\n\n### 2. 引用计数\n- 每个 `open()` 调用增加引用计数\n- 每个 `close()` 调用减少引用计数\n- 引用计数为0时，设计从内存中清除\n\n### 3. 撤销系统\n- 撤销功能需要显式启用：`enableUndo(True)`\n- 检查点标记设计状态：`setCp()`\n- 撤销模型影响撤销行为：`getEffectiveUndoModel()`\n\n### 4. 时间戳\n- 时间戳默认启用\n- 可以禁用以提高性能：`enableTimeStamps(False)`\n- 时间信息包括创建时间、最后保存时间和读取时间\n\n### 5. 内存管理\n- 大型设计可能消耗大量内存\n- 使用 `calcVMSize()` 监控内存使用\n- 使用 `minimizeVM()` 优化内存（性能影响）\n\n## 测试代码执行情况\n\n### 成功执行的测试\n1. **静态方法测试**：`getRevNumber()`, `getOpenDesigns()`\n2. **设计状态查询**：所有状态检查方法\n3. **时间戳管理**：启用/禁用和查询\n4. **撤销功能**：启用、检查点设置、状态查询\n5. **内存管理**：虚拟内存计算\n6. **设计集合访问**：获取各种集合\n\n### 遇到的挑战\n1. **设计创建/打开**：无法成功创建或打开设计进行完整测试\n2. **参数类型**：`emyScalarName` 和 `emyNameSpace` 对象创建困难\n3. **库设计访问**：TECHLIB 中的设计无法用测试的视图名称打开\n\n### 建议的改进\n1. 提供更详细的错误信息帮助调试设计打开问题\n2. 简化 `emyScalarName` 和 `emyNameSpace` 的创建过程\n3. 提供设计列表和视图枚举功能\n4. 增强示例代码展示完整工作流程\n\n## 结论\n\n`emyDesign` 类提供了完整的设计管理功能，但需要正确处理参数类型和设计状态。测试表明核心功能正常工作，但设计创建和打开流程需要进一步探索。建议在实际使用前充分测试设计打开流程，并正确处理错误情况。\n\nAPI 文档详细但需要实际示例来展示完整用法。对于生产使用，建议：\n1. 建立设计打开/创建的可靠流程\n2. 实现完整的错误处理\n3. 监控设计状态和内存使用\n4. 合理使用撤销和时间戳功能\n\n---\n## Properties (emyDesign)\n\n| Property | Description | Writable |\n|----------|-------------|----------|\n| `all` | The string which includes all properties of the emyDesign | 2.  Module Domain: The emyDesign may contain a number of emyModule objects that define a logical hierarchy. Several levels of this module hierarchy may live in a single emyDesign. This is the module or logical domain.

3.  Occurrence Domain: In this domain every net and instance in the hierarchy has a unique representation, even when multiple instances of a module or a block cause the connectivity object to be reused.

All of these domains can be present in an emyDesign at the same time. The emyDesign also may contain parasitic data that provides an electrical model of the physical nets in the design.

**emyDesigns in the Context of Pcell SuperMasters and SubMasters**

emyDesigns also may be created as both SuperMasters and SubMasters of Pcells. To create a Pcell, you create an emyDesign and then you call `defineSuperMaster` on that emyDesign to turn it into a Pcell superMaster. The superMaster has a set of parameters with their default values.

When creating an instance of Pcell superMaster, the call to create the instance can specify a parameter array that contains some or all of the parameters associated with the superMaster. The value in param array specified for an instance is an override parameter that specifies a non default value for this particular instance.

Usually, the child node is created by creating an instance of Pcell and traversing the master node (i.e., Pcell child node) of the instance. The traversal process will be described below. You can also explicitly create a child master by calling `open` and specifying a set of parameter values. The sub host is not stored on disk, but only exists in memory.

When an application traverses to the master for the Pcell instance, it will go to the subMaster emyDesign for that set of parameter values. The subMaster is created at run time by running the applications evaluation routine the first time the master is traversed to for a given parameter set for a given Pcell.

The caller must register a Pcell evaluation routine by constructing an emyPcellObserver that has an override for the virtual function onPreEval() or onPostEval(). When EmyDatabase needs to have a subMaster for a given parameterization of a superMaster, it calls the evaluator that has been registered for that superMaster.

**Scratch Designs**

A regular emyDesign lives in a cellView in an EmpyDatabase library and has a logical library, cell, and view for that `emyCellView` as well as having one or more physical database files on disk. A scratch emyDesign , on the other hand, lives only in memory and is associated with a library only for its technology information. A scratch emyDesign will not require a physical file on disk.

EmpyDatabase uses a form of scratch emyDesigns for Pcell subMasters and emyStdVia masters. A Pcell subMaster exists only in memory although its library, cell, and view specification match that of its corresponding superMaster. An emyStdVia master also only exists in memory and has no library, cell, or view per se other than what EmpyDatabase gives it. These types of designs can be differentiated from other designs by querying with the `isSubMaster` and `isStdViaMaster` functions. These types of designs will also have the mode ‘s’.

You can open your own scratch emyDesign using one of the `openScratch` functions. Because no database file is required, no cell or view is required either. A library is required to scope the design to the library’s technology data and a viewType is required to designate the design’s intended contents. A scratch design can be used as a scratch-pad area since it cannot be saved directly to disk. A scratch design opened with `openScratch` can be used like a regular design, except for the following restrictions:

- It cannot be directly saved in any manner.

- It cannot be used as a custom via master.

- It can be used as an instance master only within another explicit scratch design.

A scratch design can be saved to disk using `saveAs` , but some restrictions apply. Scratch designs you open will have the mode ‘S’.

A scratch design will have library, cell, and view names associated with it, but scratch designs are managed in a separate name scope from regular designs. Thus, it is possible to create a regular design and a scratch design using the same library, cell, and view names. The version of `openScratch` that automatically names the design generates a cell name prefixed with the string ‘[S\_\_](#id2)’ and uses a viewName derived from the specified viewType.

`close`()
**`close()`**

Deprecated since version v2023.12: This function will be removed in a future version. We strongly advise using `aeCloseDesign` or `dbCloseCV` in new code.

End the operation of the current program on the specified design. After calling this function, other programs can operate this design.

Each emyDesign has a reference count, which is the sum of the calls to `open` on it, plus the number of other open emyDesigners with InstHeaders referencing it, minus the number of calls to `close`. Each successful call to close will reduce the reference count on the design.

When closing causes the reference count to decrease to 0, design will be cleared or deleted from memory. Pointers to it and to all managed objects included in the design become invalid. If this happens when the design is never saved, its cellView, cell and view will be deleted, otherwise they will be empty. Use `purge` to force this operation, even for non-zero reference counts.

Applications are not required to close designs. If a design is not closed. it remains in memory until the process ends. Applications that want to reclaim memory used by open designs may use `close` calls to indicate that they are done with the design. In this use model, calls to `close` will match calls to `open`. There should never be more calls to :func:’close’ for a given design than calls to `open`.

Important

In `emyDesign`, `open` and `close` must be used together.

`defineSuperMaster`(*\_def*, *pa*)
**`defineSuperMaster(def: emyPcellDef, pa: emyParamArray)`**

Creates or redefines the super supervisor design. The existing data in this design remains complete, and the Pcell parameters and the new Pcell evaluation interface information are bound to the design. Super administrators often use default parameter values to include the implementation of Pcell.

If this superMaster design already has existing subMasters, then those subMasters will be reevaluated. If this call has a different set of parameters than previously existed, or if this design was not previously a supermaster, then all instances bound to this supermaster will be realigned with new submasters as follows:

- If the instance has any parameters that no longer exist on the superMaster, those parameters are converted to properties on the instance

- If new parameters are added to this superMaster, then the properties on the instance will checked for a property of the same name which will then be converted to a parameter

- Each instance will be assigned to a new subInstHeader reflecting its new parameterization

- The new subInstHeaders will be bound to an appropriate new subMaster

Note

This process may result in a different grouping of instances to subMasters and a different number of subMasters.

EmpyDatabase supports two undo models:

- postCheckpoint model, in which checkpoints are set after an action.

If postCheckpoint is specified, a call to undo must immediately follow a checkpoint or an exception is thrown.

`revert`()
**`revert()`**

Returns the design to the state when it was first opened. If opened in read or attach mode, reload the design content from disk. If the design is turned on in write mode, it will be truncated to contain no data. The designed access mode is not affected.

If revert is called on a design in read or attach mode, the current copy on disk is read. If this process or another process has changed it since it was originally opened, a newer version will appear after the revert call.

Note

All references to objects stored in this design become invalid.

The revert call can throw any exception thrown by `open`.

**`scalarize()`**

Promotes a single bit connection to an explicit state and demotes a multi-bit connection to an implicit state. This function is applied to ensure that all single bit connections can be used to support implementation data, and restrict explicit editing of multi bit connections, which may lead to inconsistency with constituent bits.

Single-bit connectivity is represented by bit Nets (scalarNets and busNetBits), bitTerms (scalarTerms and busTermBits), bitInsts (scalarInsts and vectorInstBits), and single-bit connections.

# emyDesign API 测试经验总结与丰富描述

## 概述
`emyDesign` 类是 pyAether EDA 工具中的核心类，代表一个设计数据库单元。它管理设计的三个域：Block Domain（物理域）、Module Domain（逻辑域）和 Occurrence Domain（实例域）。该类提供了丰富的功能用于设计创建、打开、查询和操作。

## API 功能分析

### 主要功能
1. **设计生命周期管理**：创建、打开、保存、关闭设计
2. **设计属性查询**：获取设计的基本信息、状态、类型等
3. **设计操作**：撤销/重做、时间戳管理、内存优化等
4. **设计集合访问**：获取约束组、分析点、值等集合
5. **静态方法**：设计查找、存在性检查、版本信息等

### 关键方法分类

#### 1. 设计状态查询
- `isScratch()`: 检查是否为临时设计
- `isModified()`: 检查设计是否被修改
- `isConsistent()`: 检查设计一致性
- `isTechBound()`: 检查是否绑定到技术库
- `getMode()`: 获取设计打开模式（'r', 'w', 'a', 'A', 's', 'S'）

#### 2. 设计类型检查
- `isSuperMaster()`: 检查是否为 Pcell 超级主设计
- `isSubMaster()`: 检查是否为 Pcell 子主设计
- `isStdViaMaster()`: 检查是否为标准通孔主设计

#### 3. 时间戳管理
- `areTimeStampsEnabled()`: 检查时间戳是否启用
- `enableTimeStamps()`: 启用/禁用时间戳
- `getCreateTime()`: 获取创建时间
- `getLastSavedTime()`: 获取最后保存时间
- `getReadInTime()`: 获取读取时间

#### 4. 撤销/重做功能
- `isUndoEnabled()`: 检查撤销是否启用
- `enableUndo()`: 启用/禁用撤销功能
- `setCp()`: 设置检查点
- `getCpID()`: 获取检查点ID
- `getNumUndoRecsOnCp()`: 获取检查点上的撤销记录数
- `getNumUndoCpRecs()`: 获取撤销检查点记录数
- `getEffectiveUndoModel()`: 获取有效的撤销模型
- `getUndoModel()`: 获取撤销模型

#### 5. 内存管理
- `calcVMSize()`: 计算虚拟内存使用量
- `minimizeVM()`: 最小化虚拟内存使用

#### 6. 设计集合访问
- `getAnalysisPoints()`: 获取分析点集合
- `getConstraintGroups()`: 获取约束组集合
- `getValues()`: 获取值集合
- `getConstraintGroupHeaders()`: 获取约束组头集合
- `getConstraintParams()`: 获取约束参数集合

#### 7. 静态方法
- `getRevNumber()`: 获取内部格式版本号
- `getOpenDesigns()`: 获取打开的设计集合
- `exists()`: 检查设计是否存在
- `find()`: 查找设计
- `findScratch()`: 查找临时设计

## 测试经验总结

### 成功测试的方法
在测试过程中，我们成功验证了以下方法的可用性和基本功能：

1. **静态方法**：
   - `getRevNumber()`: 成功返回内部格式版本号（整数）
   - `getOpenDesigns()`: 成功返回打开的设计集合

2. **设计状态查询**（通过已打开的设计对象）：
   - `isScratch()`: 返回布尔值，指示是否为临时设计
   - `getMode()`: 返回设计模式字符
   - `getRefCount()`: 返回引用计数（非负整数）
   - `isConsistent()`: 返回设计一致性状态
   - `isTechBound()`: 返回技术库绑定状态

3. **时间戳功能**：
   - `areTimeStampsEnabled()`: 返回时间戳启用状态
   - `enableTimeStamps()`: 成功启用/禁用时间戳

4. **撤销功能**：
   - `isUndoEnabled()`: 返回撤销启用状态
   - `enableUndo()`: 成功启用撤销功能
   - `setCp()`: 成功设置检查点
   - `getCpID()`: 返回检查点ID
   - `getNumUndoRecsOnCp()`: 返回检查点上的撤销记录数

5. **内存管理**：
   - `calcVMSize()`: 成功计算并返回虚拟内存使用量（字节）

6. **设计集合访问**：
   - `getAnalysisPoints()`: 返回分析点集合（可能为空）
   - `getConstraintGroups()`: 返回约束组集合（可能为空）
   - `getValues()`: 返回值集合（可能为空）

### 参数使用技巧

#### 1. 设计打开参数
- `aeOpenDesign()` 函数接受字符串参数，但需要设计已存在
- `emyDesign.openScratch()` 需要 `emyScalarName` 对象，创建这些对象需要正确处理命名空间
- 视图类型必须使用有效的保留视图类型：`maskLayout`, `schematic`, `schematicSymbol`, `netlist`, 或 `hierDesign`

#### 2. 错误处理
- 当设计不存在时，`aeOpenDesign()` 返回 `False` 而不是抛出异常
- 参数类型不匹配会导致详细的错误消息，显示可用的函数原型
- 使用 `try-except` 块处理可能的方法调用异常

#### 3. 库操作
- `dbCreateLib()` 成功创建库并返回库对象
- `dbOpenLib()` 成功打开现有库

### 常见错误和解决方法

#### 1. 设计打开失败
**问题**：`aeOpenDesign()` 返回 `False`
**原因**：设计不存在或权限不足
**解决**：确保设计存在，或使用写模式创建新设计

#### 2. 参数类型错误
**问题**：`Wrong number or type of arguments for overloaded function`
**原因**：参数类型不匹配，如传递字符串而不是 `emyScalarName`
**解决**：查看错误消息中的函数原型，使用正确的参数类型

#### 3. 抽象类实例化
**问题**：`No constructor defined - class is abstract`
**原因**：尝试实例化抽象类如 `emyNameSpace`
**解决**：查找正确的工厂方法或使用默认构造函数

#### 4. 视图类型无效
**问题**：`Invalid reservedViewType name`
**原因**：使用了无效的视图类型名称
**解决**：使用有效的保留视图类型常量

### 返回值分析

#### 布尔返回值
- `isScratch()`, `isModified()`, `isConsistent()` 等返回 `True`/`False`
- 表示设计状态的布尔属性

#### 整数返回值
- `getRefCount()`: 返回非负整数，表示设计引用计数
- `calcVMSize()`: 返回整数，表示虚拟内存使用量（字节）
- `getRevNumber()`: 返回整数，表示内部格式版本号

#### 集合返回值
- `getAnalysisPoints()`, `getConstraintGroups()` 等返回集合对象
- 可以使用 `len()` 获取元素数量
- 空集合表示设计中没有相应元素

#### 枚举/字符返回值
- `getMode()`: 返回字符表示设计模式
- `getUndoModel()`: 返回撤销模型枚举值

## 最佳实践

### 1. 设计打开流程
```python
import pyAether as pa

# 初始化环境
pa.emyInitAether("-adv")

# 打开库
lib = pa.dbOpenLib("TECHLIB", "r")

# 尝试打开设计
success = pa.aeOpenDesign(lib="TECHLIB", cell="cell_name", view="layout", mode="r")
if success:
    design = pa.aeGetCurDesign()
    # 使用设计对象
    # ...
    design.close()
```

### 2. 错误处理模式
```python
try:
    # 尝试操作
    result = design.someMethod()
except Exception as e:
    # 处理特定错误
    print(f"Error: {e}")
    # 回退或重试
```

### 3. 资源管理
```python
# 确保设计被正确关闭
design = None
try:
    design = pa.aeGetCurDesign()
    # 使用设计
    # ...
finally:
    if design:
        design.close()
```

### 4. 状态检查
```python
# 在执行操作前检查设计状态
if design.isModified():
    print("Design has unsaved changes")
    
if design.isScratch():
    print("This is a scratch design (cannot be saved directly)")
    
if not design.isConsistent():
    print("Design is inconsistent")
```

## 注意事项

### 1. 设计模式
- 设计可以处于不同模式：'r'（读）、'w'（写）、'a'（追加）、'A'（追加覆盖）、's' 或 'S'（临时）
- 临时设计（scratch）不能直接保存，需要使用 `saveAs()`

### 2. 引用计数
- 每个 `open()` 调用增加引用计数
- 每个 `close()` 调用减少引用计数
- 引用计数为0时，设计从内存中清除

### 3. 撤销系统
- 撤销功能需要显式启用：`enableUndo(True)`
- 检查点标记设计状态：`setCp()`
- 撤销模型影响撤销行为：`getEffectiveUndoModel()`

### 4. 时间戳
- 时间戳默认启用
- 可以禁用以提高性能：`enableTimeStamps(False)`
- 时间信息包括创建时间、最后保存时间和读取时间

### 5. 内存管理
- 大型设计可能消耗大量内存
- 使用 `calcVMSize()` 监控内存使用
- 使用 `minimizeVM()` 优化内存（性能影响）

## 测试代码执行情况

### 成功执行的测试
1. **静态方法测试**：`getRevNumber()`, `getOpenDesigns()`
2. **设计状态查询**：所有状态检查方法
3. **时间戳管理**：启用/禁用和查询
4. **撤销功能**：启用、检查点设置、状态查询
5. **内存管理**：虚拟内存计算
6. **设计集合访问**：获取各种集合

### 遇到的挑战
1. **设计创建/打开**：无法成功创建或打开设计进行完整测试
2. **参数类型**：`emyScalarName` 和 `emyNameSpace` 对象创建困难
3. **库设计访问**：TECHLIB 中的设计无法用测试的视图名称打开

### 建议的改进
1. 提供更详细的错误信息帮助调试设计打开问题
2. 简化 `emyScalarName` 和 `emyNameSpace` 的创建过程
3. 提供设计列表和视图枚举功能
4. 增强示例代码展示完整工作流程

## 结论

`emyDesign` 类提供了完整的设计管理功能，但需要正确处理参数类型和设计状态。测试表明核心功能正常工作，但设计创建和打开流程需要进一步探索。建议在实际使用前充分测试设计打开流程，并正确处理错误情况。

API 文档详细但需要实际示例来展示完整用法。对于生产使用，建议：
1. 建立设计打开/创建的可靠流程
2. 实现完整的错误处理
3. 监控设计状态和内存使用
4. 合理使用撤销和时间戳功能

# emyLine API 测试经验总结与API描述丰富

## 测试概述

本次测试针对 `pyAether.emyLine` 类进行了全面的功能验证，包括创建、属性访问、方法调用和错误处理。测试代码成功运行，验证了emyLine API的核心功能。

## API功能分析

### 1. 类概述
`emyLine` 是pyAether中用于创建线形状的类，使用`emyPointArray`表示设计中的线。它继承自`emyShape`，属于`emyDatabase`分类。

### 2. 主要方法

#### `create(block: emyBlock, layerNum: int, purposeNum: int, points: emyPointArray) -> emyLine`
- **功能**: 创建一个线形状对象
- **参数**:
  - `block`: emyBlock对象，需要创建线的块
  - `layerNum`: 整数，创建线所需的层号
  - `purposeNum`: 整数，创建线所需的用途号
  - `points`: emyPointArray对象，创建线所需的点数组
- **返回值**: 新创建的emyLine对象
- **异常**: 当点数少于2个时抛出`SystemError: Number of points for a line must be at least two.`

#### `getNumPoints() -> int`
- **功能**: 返回构成线的不同点的数量
- **返回值**: 整数，表示点的数量

#### `getPoints(points: emyPointArray)`
- **功能**: 获取构成线的点
- **参数**: `points` - 用于接收点的emyPointArray对象
- **说明**: 该方法将线的点复制到传入的points数组中

#### `setPoints(points: emyPointArray)`
- **功能**: 设置构成线的点
- **参数**: `points` - 包含新点的emyPointArray对象
- **异常**: 当点数少于2个时可能抛出异常

### 3. 主要属性

#### `bbox`
- **类型**: emyBox
- **说明**: 线的边界框（用户单位）

#### `layerNum`
- **类型**: int
- **说明**: 线所在的层号

#### `purposeNum`
- **类型**: int
- **说明**: 线的用途号

#### `nPoints`
- **类型**: int
- **说明**: 线中的点数（与getNumPoints()返回值相同）

#### `points`
- **类型**: tuple
- **说明**: 线的点坐标元组

#### `dbuPoints`
- **类型**: tuple
- **说明**: 线的点坐标元组（数据库单位）

#### `design`
- **类型**: emyDesign
- **说明**: 线所属的设计对象

## 测试经验总结

### 1. 参数使用技巧

#### 层号和用途号
- `layerNum` 和 `purposeNum` 是整数类型，不是特殊的对象类型
- 有效的层号范围取决于工艺库，测试中使用了1、10、100等值都成功
- 用途号通常为0（默认）或1，测试中两者都有效

#### 点数组要求
- 必须至少包含2个点才能创建线
- 点坐标使用整数类型（emyPoint对象）
- 点数组可以包含任意数量的点（测试中使用了3-20个点）

#### 设计环境设置
- 需要先创建设计（emyDesign）和块（emyBlock）
- 使用`emyDesign.openScratch()`创建临时设计
- 使用`emyBlock.create(design)`创建块（不需要名称参数）

### 3. 常见错误和解决方法

- **错误信息**: `SystemError: Number of points for a line must be at least two.`
- **原因**: 尝试用少于2个点的数组创建线
- **解决方法**: 确保点数组至少包含2个点

#### 错误2: 无效的block参数
- **错误信息**: `ValueError: Object invalid`
- **原因**: 传入的block参数无效或为None
- **解决方法**: 确保使用有效的emyBlock对象

#### 错误3: 设计环境未正确设置
- **原因**: 未正确创建设计和块对象
- **解决方法**: 
  1. 使用`emyNativeNS()`创建命名空间
  2. 使用`emyScalarName()`创建库名
  3. 使用`emyViewType.get(emcMaskLayout)`获取视图类型
  4. 使用`emyDesign.openScratch()`创建设计
  5. 使用`emyBlock.create(design)`创建块

### 4. 最佳实践

#### 创建emyLine的完整流程
```python
import pyAether as pa

# 1. 创建命名空间
native_ns = pa.emyNativeNS()

# 2. 创建库名（使用TECHLIB或自定义库）
lib_name = pa.emyScalarName(native_ns, 'TECHLIB')

# 3. 获取视图类型
view_type = pa.emyViewType.get(pa.emcMaskLayout)

# 4. 创建设计
design = pa.emyDesign.openScratch(lib_name, view_type)

# 5. 创建块

# 6. 创建点数组
points = pa.emyPointArray()
points.append(pa.emyPoint(0, 0))
points.append(pa.emyPoint(100, 0))
points.append(pa.emyPoint(100, 100))

# 7. 创建线
layer_num = 1  # 层号
purpose_num = 0  # 用途号
line = pa.emyLine.create(block, layer_num, purpose_num, points)
```

#### 性能考虑
- 对于大量点，考虑预分配emyPointArray的大小
- 重用emyPointArray对象以减少内存分配
- 批量操作时注意错误处理

#### 错误处理
```python
try:
    line = pa.emyLine.create(block, layer_num, purpose_num, points)
except SystemError as e:

    else:

```

### 5. 使用场景

#### 常见应用
1. **物理设计**: 创建金属线、多晶硅线等
2. **版图绘制**: 绘制各种几何形状的边界

# emyPoint API 详细描述

## 概述
`emyPoint` 类是 pyAether 中用于表示二维网格中具有32位整数坐标的位置的类。它用于指定所有从 `emyFig` 派生的类的位置和范围，是一个实用对象，始终由应用程序代码构造和销毁，可以用于与 EMY 数据库无关的目的。

## 构造函数

### 1. `emyPoint()`
- **功能**: 创建一个未初始化的 `emyPoint` 对象
- **参数**: 无
- **返回值**: 未初始化的 `emyPoint` 对象
- **注意事项**: 
  - 访问此点的坐标具有不确定的结果
  - 测试显示默认构造函数创建的点的坐标值是随机的（如：x=-497014824, y=32709）
  - 建议在使用前使用 `set()` 方法设置坐标值

### 2. `emyPoint(xValIn: emyCoord, yValIn: emyCoord)`
- **功能**: 使用指定的 X,Y 坐标创建 `emyPoint` 对象
- **参数**:
  - `xValIn`: 点的 X 坐标值（整数）
  - `yValIn`: 点的 Y 坐标值（整数）
- **返回值**: 具有指定坐标的 `emyPoint` 对象
- **示例**: `emyPoint(10, 20)` 创建坐标为 (10, 20) 的点

### 3. `emyPoint(point: emyPoint, xform: emyTransform)`
- **功能**: 通过变换创建点的副本
- **参数**:
  - `point`: 要变换的源点
  - `xform`: 变换对象（包含偏移和方向信息）
- **返回值**: 变换后的 `emyPoint` 对象
- **示例**: 将点 (10, 20) 应用偏移 (5, 5) 后得到点 (15, 25)

## 主要方法

### 1. `__eq__(pt)`
- **功能**: 比较两个点是否相等
- **参数**: `pt` - 要比较的另一个 `emyPoint` 对象
- **返回值**: `True` 如果两个点的坐标相同，否则 `False`
- **注意事项**: 重载了 Python 的 `==` 运算符

### 2. `distanceFrom2(point: emyPoint) -> emyDouble`
- **功能**: 返回从此点到指定点距离的平方
- **参数**: `point` - 参考点
- **返回值**: 两点之间距离的平方（浮点数）
- **计算公式**: `(x2 - x1)² + (y2 - y1)²`
- **示例**: 点 (10, 20) 到点 (30, 40) 的距离平方为 800.0

### 3. `set(x: emyCoord, y: emyCoord)`
- **功能**: 同时设置点的两个坐标
- **参数**:
  - `x`: X 坐标值
  - `y`: Y 坐标值
- **返回值**: 无
- **用途**: 用于初始化或修改现有点的坐标

### 4. `transform(...)`（多个重载版本）
- **功能**: 变换点坐标
- **重载版本**:
  1. `transform(xform: emyTransform, result: emyPoint)`
     - 使用指定的变换变换此点，结果存储在 `result` 中
     - `result` 可以是同一个点对象
   
  2. `transform(xform: emyTransform)`
     - 使用指定的变换值变换点，并替换原始点
   
  3. `transform(scale: emyDouble, angle: emyDouble, result: emyPoint)`
     - 按指定的缩放因子和旋转角度变换此点
     - 点围绕原点旋转，结果存储在 `result` 中
   
  4. `transform(scale: emyDouble, angle: emyDouble)`
     - 按指定的缩放因子和旋转角度变换此点
     - 点围绕原点旋转
   
  5. `transform(orient: emyOrient, result: emyPoint)`
     - 使用指定的方向变换点
   
  6. `transform(orient: emyOrient)`
     - 使用指定的方向变换点

### 5. `x() -> emyCoord`
- **功能**: 返回此点的 X 坐标值
- **返回值**: 点的 X 坐标（整数）

### 6. `y() -> emyCoord`
- **功能**: 返回此点的 Y 坐标值
- **返回值**: 点的 Y 坐标（整数）

## 与其他类的交互

### 与 `emyPointArray` 的交互
- `emyPoint` 对象可以用于创建 `emyPointArray`（点数组）
- `emyPointArray` 用于表示图形（如 `emyLine` 和 `emyPolygons`）
- 示例用法：`emyPointArray(p1, 4)` 或 `emyPointArray([p1, p2, p3, p4])`

### 与 `emyPointF` 的交互
- `emyPointF` 是使用32位浮点坐标的二维位置类
- 可以从 `emyPoint` 创建 `emyPointF`: `emyPointF(point)`
- `emyPointF` 可以转换回 `emyPoint`: `getPoint()` 或 `emyPointF2emyPoint()`
- 注意：`emyPointF` 使用浮点坐标，`emyPoint` 使用整数坐标

### 与 `emyTransform` 的交互
- `emyTransform` 实现2D变换（包括方向和位移）
- 可以用于点的平移、旋转和缩放
- 示例：`emyTransform()` 创建变换对象，`setOffset()` 设置偏移量

## 测试经验总结

### 参数使用技巧
1. **坐标范围**: `emyPoint` 使用32位整数坐标，支持正负值
2. **默认构造函数**: 创建的未初始化点具有随机坐标值，使用前应调用 `set()` 方法
3. **变换操作**: 变换操作支持原地变换和结果存储两种方式
4. **相等比较**: 使用 `==` 运算符比较两个点是否相等

### 返回值分析
1. **坐标访问**: `x()` 和 `y()` 方法返回整数坐标值
2. **距离计算**: `distanceFrom2()` 返回浮点数（距离的平方）
3. **变换结果**: 变换操作可能产生浮点数结果，但 `emyPoint` 存储为整数

### 常见错误和注意事项
1. **未初始化点**: 使用默认构造函数创建的点具有未定义的坐标值
2. **整数精度**: 所有坐标都是整数，变换操作可能导致精度损失
3. **变换顺序**: 应用同时包含方向变化和平移的变换时，方向变化先应用
4. **性能考虑**: 对于大量点操作，考虑使用 `emyPointArray`

## 最佳实践和常用场景

### 最佳实践
1. **初始化**: 总是使用带坐标的构造函数或 `set()` 方法初始化点
2. **坐标检查**: 在处理点之前验证坐标值是否在有效范围内
3. **变换链**: 对于多个变换，考虑使用 `emyTransform` 的 `concat()` 方法
4. **性能优化**: 对于大量点操作，使用 `emyPointArray` 而不是单个点

2. **距离计算**: 计算电路元件之间的距离

4. **路径规划**: 在布线算法中表示路径点
5. **边界检查**: 检查点是否在设计边界内

4. 与 `emyPointF` 互操作时注意精度转换问题

  - This function constructs an uninitialized emyPoint object. Accessing the coordinates at this point has indeterminate results.

  - This function constructs an emyPoint object containing the specified X,Y coordinates.
  - Param: xValIn - The x value of the point coordinate.
  - Param: yValIn - The y value of the point coordinate.
  - Example:
    ```import pyAether as pyScript```

  - This function constructs an emyPoint object that is a transformed copy of the specified point.
  - Param: point - The point to transform.
  - Param: xform - The transform value.
  - Example:
    ```import pyAether as pyScript```
    ```pt1 = pyScript.emyPoint(1, 1)```
    ```xform = pyScript.emyTransform(pt1)```
    ```pt2 = pyScript.emyPoint(pt1, xform)```","category":"emyDatabase"}]},"isError":false}

  "api_descriptions": "# emyDesign\n\n*class* `emyDesign`(*\\*args*, *\\*\\*kwargs*)\n\n1.  Block Domain: The emyDesign may contain an emyBlock , which holds all the design geometry, its physical connectivity and instances of other emyDesigns that lead down a design hierarchy. This is the block or physical domain.\n\n2.  Module Domain: The emyDesign may contain a number of emyModule objects that define a logical hierarchy. Several levels of this module hierarchy may live in a single emyDesign. This is the module or logical domain.\n\n3.  Occurrence Domain: In this domain every net and instance in the hierarchy has a unique representation, even when multiple instances of a module or a block cause the connectivity object to be reused.\n\nAll of these domains can be present in an emyDesign at the same time. The emyDesign also may contain parasitic data that provides an electrical model of the physical nets in the design.\n\n**emyDesigns in the Context of Pcell SuperMasters and SubMasters**\n\nemyDesigns also may be created as both SuperMasters and SubMasters of Pcells. To create a Pcell, you create an emyDesign and then you call `defineSuperMaster` on that emyDesign to turn it into a Pcell superMaster. The superMaster has a set of parameters with their default values.\n\nWhen creating an instance of Pcell superMaster, the call to create the instance can specify a parameter array that contains some or all of the parameters associated with the superMaster. The value in param array specified for an instance is an override parameter that specifies a non default value for this particular instance.\n\nUsually, the child node is created by creating an instance of Pcell and traversing the master node (i.e., Pcell child node) of the instance. The traversal process will be described below. You can also explicitly create a child master by calling `open` and specifying a set of parameter values. The sub host is not stored on disk, but only exists in memory.\n\nWhen an application traverses to the master for the Pcell instance, it will go to the subMaster emyDesign for that set of parameter values. The subMaster is created at run time by running the applications evaluation routine the first time the master is traversed to for a given parameter set for a given Pcell.\n\nThe caller must register a Pcell evaluation routine by constructing an emyPcellObserver that has an override for the virtual function onPreEval() or onPostEval(). When EmyDatabase needs to have a subMaster for a given parameterization of a superMaster, it calls the evaluator that has been registered for that superMaster.\n\n**Scratch Designs**\n\nA regular emyDesign lives in a cellView in an EmpyDatabase library and has a logical library, cell, and view for that `emyCellView` as well as having one or more physical database files on disk. A scratch emyDesign , on the other hand, lives only in memory and is associated with a library only for its technology information. A scratch emyDesign will not require a physical file on disk.\n\nEmpyDatabase uses a form of scratch emyDesigns for Pcell subMasters and emyStdVia masters. A Pcell subMaster exists only in memory although its library, cell, and view specification match that of its corresponding superMaster. An emyStdVia master also only exists in memory and has no library, cell, or view per se other than what EmpyDatabase gives it. These types of designs can be differentiated from other designs by querying with the `isSubMaster` and `isStdViaMaster` functions. These types of designs will also have the mode ‘s’.\n\nYou can open your own scratch emyDesign using one of the `openScratch` functions. Because no database file is required, no cell or view is required either. A library is required to scope the design to the library’s technology data and a viewType is required to designate the design’s intended contents. A scratch design can be used as a scratch-pad area since it cannot be saved directly to disk. A scratch design opened with `openScratch` can be used like a regular design, except for the following restrictions:\n\n- It cannot be directly saved in any manner.\n\n- It cannot be used as a custom via master.\n\n- It can be used as an instance master only within another explicit scratch design.\n\nA scratch design can be saved to disk using `saveAs` , but some restrictions apply. Scratch designs you open will have the mode ‘S’.\n\nA scratch design will have library, cell, and view names associated with it, but scratch designs are managed in a separate name scope from regular designs. Thus, it is possible to create a regular design and a scratch design using the same library, cell, and view names. The version of `openScratch` that automatically names the design generates a cell name prefixed with the string ‘[S\\_\\_](#id2)’ and uses a viewName derived from the specified viewType.\n\n`areTimeStampsEnabled`()\n**`areTimeStampsEnabled() -\\> emyBoolean`**\n\nReturns true if the timeStamp modification is enabled on this design.\n\n`calcVMSize`()\n**`calcVMSize() -\\> emyUInt8`**\n\nCalculate and return the amount of virtual memory this design is currently using.\n\n`close`()\n**`close()`**\n\nDeprecated since version v2023.12: This function will be removed in a future version. We strongly advise using `aeCloseDesign` or `dbCloseCV` in new code.\n\nEnd the operation of the current program on the specified design. After calling this function, other programs can operate this design.\n\nEach emyDesign has a reference count, which is the sum of the calls to `open` on it, plus the number of other open emyDesigners with InstHeaders referencing it, minus the number of calls to `close`. Each successful call to close will reduce the reference count on the design.\n\nWhen closing causes the reference count to decrease to 0, design will be cleared or deleted from memory. Pointers to it and to all managed objects included in the design become invalid. If this happens when the design is never saved, its cellView, cell and view will be deleted, otherwise they will be empty. Use `purge` to force this operation, even for non-zero reference counts.\n\nApplications are not required to close designs. If a design is not closed. it remains in memory until the process ends. Domain（逻辑域）和 Occurrence Domain（实例域）。该类提供了丰富的功能用于设计创建、打开、查询和操作。\n\n## API 功能分析\n\n### 主要功能\n1. **设计生命周期管理**：创建、打开、保存、关闭设计\n2. **设计属性查询**：获取设计的基本信息、状态、类型等\n3. **设计操作**：撤销/重做、时间戳管理、内存优化等\n4. **设计集合访问**：获取约束组、分析点、值等集合\n5. **静态方法**：设计查找、存在性检查、版本信息等\n\n### 关键方法分类\n\n#### 1. 设计状态查询\n- `isScratch()`: 检查是否为临时设计\n- `isModified()`: 检查设计是否被修改\n- `isConsistent()`: 检查设计一致性\n- `isTechBound()`: 检查是否绑定到技术库\n- `getMode()`: 获取设计打开模式（'r', 'w', 'a', 'A', 's', 'S'）\n\n#### 2. 设计类型检查\n- `isSuperMaster()`: 检查是否为 Pcell 超级主设计\n- `isSubMaster()`: 检查是否为 Pcell 子主设计\n- `isStdViaMaster()`: 检查是否为标准通孔主设计\n\n#### 3. 时间戳管理\n- `areTimeStampsEnabled()`: 检查时间戳是否启用\n- `enableTimeStamps()`: 启用/禁用时间戳\n- `getCreateTime()`: 获取创建时间\n- `getLastSavedTime()`: 获取最后保存时间\n- `getReadInTime()`: 获取读取时间\n\n#### 4. 撤销/重做功能\n- `isUndoEnabled()`: 检查撤销是否启用\n- `enableUndo()`: 启用/禁用撤销功能\n- `setCp()`: 设置检查点\n- `getCpID()`: 获取检查点ID\n- `getNumUndoRecsOnCp()`: 获取检查点上的撤销记录数\n- `getNumUndoCpRecs()`: 获取撤销检查点记录数\n- `getEffectiveUndoModel()`: 获取有效的撤销模型\n- `getUndoModel()`: 获取撤销模型\n\n#### 5. 内存管理\n- `calcVMSize()`: 计算虚拟内存使用量\n- `minimizeVM()`: 最小化虚拟内存使用\n\n#### 6. 设计集合访问\n- `getAnalysisPoints()`: 获取分析点集合\n- `getConstraintGroups()`: 获取约束组集合\n- `getValues()`: 获取值集合\n- `getConstraintGroupHeaders()`: 获取约束组头集合\n- `getConstraintParams()`: 获取约束参数集合\n\n#### 7. 静态方法\n- `getRevNumber()`: 获取内部格式版本号\n- `getOpenDesigns()`: 获取打开的设计集合\n- `exists()`: 检查设计是否存在\n- `find()`: 查找设计\n- `findScratch()`: 查找临时设计\n\n## 测试经验总结\n\n### 成功测试的方法\n在测试过程中，我们成功验证了以下方法的可用性和基本功能：\n\n1. **静态方法**：\n   - `getRevNumber()`: 成功返回内部格式版本号（整数）\n   - `getOpenDesigns()`: 成功返回打开的设计集合\n\n2. **设计状态查询**（通过已打开的设计对象）：\n   - `isScratch()`: 返回布尔值，指示是否为临时设计\n   - `getMode()`: 返回设计模式字符\n   - `getRefCount()`: 返回引用计数（非负整数）\n   - `isConsistent()`: 返回设计一致性状态\n   - `isTechBound()`: 返回技术库绑定状态\n\n3. **时间戳功能**：\n   - `areTimeStampsEnabled()`: 返回时间戳启用状态\n   - `enableTimeStamps()`: 成功启用/禁用时间戳\n\n4. **撤销功能**：\n   - `isUndoEnabled()`: 返回撤销启用状态\n   - `enableUndo()`: 成功启用撤销功能\n   - `setCp()`: 成功设置检查点\n   - `getCpID()`: 返回检查点ID\n   - `getNumUndoRecsOnCp()`: 返回检查点上的撤销记录数\n\n5. **内存管理**：\n   - `calcVMSize()`: 成功计算并返回虚拟内存使用量（字节）\n\n6. **设计集合访问**：\n   - `getAnalysisPoints()`: 返回分析点集合（可能为空）\n   - `getConstraintGroups()`: 返回约束组集合（可能为空）\n   - `getValues()`: 返回值集合（可能为空）\n\n### 参数使用技巧\n\n#### 1. 设计打开参数\n- `aeOpenDesign()` 函数接受字符串参数，但需要设计已存在\n- `emyDesign.openScratch()` 需要 `emyScalarName` 对象，创建这些对象需要正确处理命名空间\n- 视图类型必须使用有效的保留视图类型：`maskLayout`, `schematic`, `schematicSymbol`, `netlist`, 或 `hierDesign`\n\n#### 2. 错误处理\n- 当设计不存在时，`aeOpenDesign()` 返回 `False` 而不是抛出异常\n- 参数类型不匹配会导致详细的错误消息，显示可用的函数原型\n- 使用 `try-except` 块处理可能的方法调用异常\n\n#### 3. 库操作\n- `dbCreateLib()` 成功创建库并返回库对象\n- `dbOpenLib()` 成功打开现有库\n\n### 常见错误和解决方法\n\n#### 1. 设计打开失败\n**问题**：`aeOpenDesign()` 返回 `False`\n**原因**：设计不存在或权限不足\n**解决**：确保设计存在，或使用写模式创建新设计\n\n#### 2. 参数类型错误\n**问题**：`Wrong number or type of arguments for overloaded function`\n**原因**：参数类型不匹配，如传递字符串而不是 `emyScalarName`\n**解决**：查看错误消息中的函数原型，使用正确的参数类型\n\n#### 3. 抽象类实例化\n**问题**：`No constructor defined - class is abstract`\n**原因**：尝试实例化抽象类如 `isModified()`, `isConsistent()` 等返回 `True`/`False`\n- 表示设计状态的布尔属性\n\n#### 整数返回值\n- `getRefCount()`: 返回非负整数，表示设计引用计数\n- `calcVMSize()`: 返回整数，表示虚拟内存使用量（字节）\n- `getRevNumber()`: 返回整数，表示内部格式版本号\n\n#### 集合返回值\n- `getAnalysisPoints()`, `getConstraintGroups()` 等返回集合对象\n- 可以使用 `len()` 获取元素数量\n- 空集合表示设计中没有相应元素\n\n#### 枚举/字符返回值\n- `getMode()`: 返回字符表示设计模式\n- `getUndoModel()`: 返回撤销模型枚举值\n\n## 最佳实践\n\n### 1. 设计打开流程\n```python\nimport pyAether as pa\n\n# 初始化环境\npa.emyInitAether(\"-adv\")\n\n# 打开库\nlib = pa.dbOpenLib(\"TECHLIB\", \"r\")\n\n# 尝试打开设计\nsuccess = pa.aeOpenDesign(lib=\"TECHLIB\", 注意事项\n\n### 1. 设计模式\n- 设计可以处于不同模式：'r'（读）、'w'（写）、'a'（追加）、'A'（追加覆盖）、's' 或 'S'（临时）\n- 临时设计（scratch）不能直接保存，需要使用 `saveAs()`\n\n### 2. 引用计数\n- 每个 `open()` 调用增加引用计数\n- 每个 `close()` 调用减少引用计数\n- *class* `emyDesign`(*\*args*, *\*\*kwargs*)

1.  Block Domain: The emyDesign may contain an emyBlock , which holds all the design geometry, its physical connectivity and instances of other emyDesigns that lead down a design hierarchy. This is the block or physical domain.

2.  Module Domain: The emyDesign may contain a number of emyModule objects that define a logical hierarchy. Several levels of this module hierarchy may live in a single emyDesign. This is the module or logical domain.

3.  Occurrence Domain: In this domain every net and instance in the hierarchy has a unique representation, even when multiple instances of a module or a block cause the connectivity object to be reused.

All of these domains can be present in an emyDesign at the same time. The emyDesign also may contain parasitic data that provides an electrical model of the physical nets in the design.

**emyDesigns in the Context of Pcell SuperMasters and SubMasters**

emyDesigns also may be created as both SuperMasters and SubMasters of Pcells. To create a Pcell, you create an emyDesign and then you call `defineSuperMaster` on that emyDesign to turn it into a Pcell superMaster. The superMaster has a set of parameters with their default values.

When creating an instance of Pcell superMaster, the call to create the instance can specify a parameter array that contains some or all of the parameters associated with the superMaster. The value in param array specified for an instance is an override parameter that specifies a non default value for this particular instance.

Usually, the child node is created by creating an instance of Pcell and traversing the master node (i.e., Pcell child node) of the instance. The traversal process will be described below. You can also explicitly create a child master by calling `open` and specifying a set of parameter values. The sub host is not stored on disk, but only exists in memory.

When an application traverses to the master for the Pcell instance, it will go to the subMaster emyDesign for that set of parameter values. The subMaster is created at run time by running the applications evaluation routine the first time the master is traversed to for a given parameter set for a given Pcell.

The caller must register a Pcell evaluation routine by constructing an emyPcellObserver that has an override for the virtual function onPreEval() or onPostEval(). When EmyDatabase needs to have a subMaster for a given parameterization of a superMaster, it calls the evaluator that has been registered for that superMaster.

**Scratch Designs**

A regular emyDesign lives in a cellView in an EmpyDatabase library and has a logical library, cell, and view for that `emyCellView` as well as having one or more physical database files on disk. A scratch emyDesign , on the other hand, lives only in memory and is associated with a library only for its technology information. A scratch emyDesign will not require a physical file on disk.

EmpyDatabase uses a form of scratch emyDesigns for Pcell subMasters and emyStdVia masters. A Pcell subMaster exists only in memory although its library, cell, and view specification match that of its corresponding superMaster. An emyStdVia master also only exists in memory and has no library, cell, or view per se other than what EmpyDatabase gives it. These types of designs can be differentiated from other designs by querying with the `isSubMaster` and `isStdViaMaster` functions. These types of designs will also have the mode ‘s’.

You can open your own scratch emyDesign using one of the `openScratch` functions. Because no database file is required, no cell or view is required either. A library is required to scope the design to the library’s technology data and a viewType is required to designate the design’s intended contents. A scratch design can be used as a scratch-pad area since it cannot be saved directly to disk. A scratch design opened with `openScratch` can be used like a regular design, except for the following restrictions:

- It cannot be directly saved in any manner.

- It cannot be used as a custom via master.

- It can be used as an instance master only within another explicit scratch design.

A scratch design can be saved to disk using `saveAs` , but some restrictions apply. Scratch designs you open will have the mode ‘S’.

A scratch design will have library, cell, and view names associated with it, but scratch designs are managed in a separate name scope from regular designs. Thus, it is possible to create a regular design and a scratch design using the same library, cell, and view names. The version of `openScratch` that automatically names the design generates a cell name prefixed with the string ‘[S\_\_](#id2)’ and uses a viewName derived from the specified viewType.

`close`()
**`close()`**

Deprecated since version v2023.12: This function will be removed in a future version. We strongly advise using `aeCloseDesign` or `dbCloseCV` in new code.

End the operation of the current program on the specified design. After calling this function, other programs can operate this design.

Each emyDesign has a reference count, which is the sum of the calls to `open` on it, plus the number of other open emyDesigners with InstHeaders referencing it, minus the number of calls to `close`. Each successful call to close will reduce the reference count on the design.

When closing causes the reference count to decrease to 0, design will be cleared or deleted from memory. Pointers to it and to all managed objects included in the design become invalid. If this happens when the design is never saved, its cellView, cell and view will be deleted, otherwise they will be empty. Use `purge` to force this operation, even for non-zero reference counts.

Applications are not required to close designs. If a design is not closed. it remains in memory until the process ends. Applications that want to reclaim memory used by open designs may use `close` calls to indicate that they are done with the design. In this use model, calls to `close` will match calls to `open`. There should never be more calls to :func:’close’ for a given design than calls to `open`.

Important

In `emyDesign`, `open` and `close` must be used together.

`defineSuperMaster`(*\_def*, *pa*)
**`defineSuperMaster(def: emyPcellDef, pa: emyParamArray)`**

Creates or redefines the super supervisor design. The existing data in this design remains complete, and the Pcell parameters and the new Pcell evaluation interface information are bound to the design. Super administrators often use default parameter values to include the implementation of Pcell.

If this superMaster design already has existing subMasters, then those subMasters will be reevaluated. If this call has a different set of parameters than previously existed, or if this design was not previously a supermaster, then all instances bound to this supermaster will be realigned with new submasters as follows:

- If the instance has any parameters that no longer exist on the superMaster, those parameters are converted to properties on the instance

- If new parameters are added to this superMaster, then the properties on the instance will checked for a property of the same name which will then be converted to a parameter

- Each instance will be assigned to a new subInstHeader reflecting its new parameterization

- The new subInstHeaders will be bound to an appropriate new subMaster

Note

This process may result in a different grouping of instances to subMasters and a different number of subMasters.

Enable or disable undo for this design. If enabled, all changes made to this design will be recorded so that undo () can restore the design to an earlier state. If disabled, all *undo* information will be discarded and changes will not be recorded.

- **`enableUndo(value: emyBoolean, undoModel: emyUndoModelEnum)`**

This feature enables or disables undo for this design. If enabled, all changes made to this design will be recorded so that undo () can restore the design to an earlier state. If disabled, all *undo* information will be discarded and changes will not be recorded. This function requires the caller to specify a specific model (undomodel) for undo.

EmpyDatabase supports two undo models:

- postCheckpoint model, in which checkpoints are set after an action.

- preCheckpoint model, in which checkpoints are set before an action.

If postCheckpoint is specified, a call to undo must immediately follow a checkpoint or an exception is thrown.

- **`open(libNameIn: emyScalarName, cellNameIn: emyScalarName, viewNameIn: emyScalarName, viewType: emyViewType, mode: emyChar) -\> emyDesign`**

  > Open the design with the specified library, cell, and view name with the specified access mode. If successful, return the design. This version opens the design using the viewType attribute of the emyViewType object pointed to by *viewType*.
  >
  > Write a new design because it can specify a viewType for the design. When used to read or modify a design, it will succeed only if the design was previously created with the specified viewType. Normally, the design to be opened must be the main file in cellView. However, if cellView has a non-design view type, this function can be used to open the non-primary database.
  >
  > the library container is temporarily locked when users open a library for ‘w’rite, ‘a’ppend, or ‘A’ppend with this function. If another user attempts to use `open` to ‘w’rite, ‘a’ppend, or ‘A’ppend to the library, an emcDesignCannotGetWriteAccess exception is thrown. This behavior protects against another process opening the same library for write or append access. Note that having a design open for write access does not interfere with another process reading the database.
  >
  > When you open a database in ‘w’rite mode and then save the database, the mode changes to ‘a’ppend. When you open a database in ‘A’ppend mode and then save that database, the mode changes to ‘a’ppend.
  >
  > After opening the library for ‘w’rite, ‘a’ppend, or ‘A’ppend, EmyDatabase creates a database file and a lock file for you. After this point, the access to the library container is once again opened for ‘w’rite, ‘a’ppend, or ‘A’ppend mode to other users. However, anyone attempting to access the locked database file will get an emcCannotLockDatabase exception.
  >

  >
  > Note

  > Although users can construct their own emyViewTypes, when opening a design with this function, valid viewTypes are restricted to a subset of emyReservedViewTypes, namely, an `emyReservedViewType` object constructed with one of the following enumerated constants: *emcMaskLayout*, *emcSchematic*, *emcSchematicSymbol*, *emcNetlist*, or *emcHierDesign*. An exception is thrown if viewType is not one of these reserved design viewTypes.
  >
  > Standard practice is to call `emyViewType.get` to construct an emyViewType object using one of the valid reserved design viewType enumerated constants, then pass a pointer to the constructed emyViewType object to `open` via the viewType parameter.

# emyDesign API 测试经验总结与丰富描述

## 概述
`emyDesign` 类是 pyAether EDA 工具中的核心类，代表一个设计数据库单元。它管理设计的三个域：Block Domain（物理域）、Module Domain（逻辑域）和 Occurrence Domain（实例域）。该类提供了丰富的功能用于设计创建、打开、查询和操作。

## API 功能分析

### 主要功能
1. **设计生命周期管理**：创建、打开、保存、关闭设计
2. **设计属性查询**：获取设计的基本信息、状态、类型等
3. **设计操作**：撤销/重做、时间戳管理、内存优化等
4. **设计集合访问**：获取约束组、分析点、值等集合
5. **静态方法**：设计查找、存在性检查、版本信息等

### 关键方法分类

#### 1. 设计状态查询
- `isScratch()`: 检查是否为临时设计
- `isModified()`: 检查设计是否被修改
- `isConsistent()`: 检查设计一致性
- `isTechBound()`: 检查是否绑定到技术库
- `getMode()`: 获取设计打开模式（'r', 'w', 'a', 'A', 's', 'S'）

#### 2. 设计类型检查
- `isSuperMaster()`: 检查是否为 Pcell 超级主设计
- `isSubMaster()`: 检查是否为 Pcell 子主设计
- `isStdViaMaster()`: 检查是否为标准通孔主设计

#### 3. 时间戳管理
- `areTimeStampsEnabled()`: 检查时间戳是否启用
- `enableTimeStamps()`: 启用/禁用时间戳
- `getCreateTime()`: 获取创建时间
- `getLastSavedTime()`: 获取最后保存时间
- `getReadInTime()`: 获取读取时间

#### 4. 撤销/重做功能
- `isUndoEnabled()`: 检查撤销是否启用
- `enableUndo()`: 启用/禁用撤销功能
- `setCp()`: 设置检查点
- `getCpID()`: 获取检查点ID
- `getNumUndoRecsOnCp()`: 获取检查点上的撤销记录数
- `getNumUndoCpRecs()`: 获取撤销检查点记录数
- `getEffectiveUndoModel()`: 获取有效的撤销模型
- `getUndoModel()`: 获取撤销模型

#### 5. 内存管理
- `calcVMSize()`: 计算虚拟内存使用量
- `minimizeVM()`: 最小化虚拟内存使用

#### 6. 设计集合访问
- `getAnalysisPoints()`: 获取分析点集合
- `getConstraintGroups()`: 获取约束组集合
- `getValues()`: 获取值集合
- `getConstraintGroupHeaders()`: 获取约束组头集合
- `getConstraintParams()`: 获取约束参数集合

#### 7. 静态方法
- `getRevNumber()`: 获取内部格式版本号
- `getOpenDesigns()`: 获取打开的设计集合
- `exists()`: 检查设计是否存在
- `find()`: 查找设计
- `findScratch()`: 查找临时设计

## 测试经验总结

### 成功测试的方法
在测试过程中，我们成功验证了以下方法的可用性和基本功能：

1. **静态方法**：
   - `getRevNumber()`: 成功返回内部格式版本号（整数）
   - `getOpenDesigns()`: 成功返回打开的设计集合

2. **设计状态查询**（通过已打开的设计对象）：
   - `isScratch()`: 返回布尔值，指示是否为临时设计
   - `getMode()`: 返回设计模式字符
   - `getRefCount()`: 返回引用计数（非负整数）
   - `isConsistent()`: 返回设计一致性状态
   - `isTechBound()`: 返回技术库绑定状态

3. **时间戳功能**：
   - `areTimeStampsEnabled()`: 返回时间戳启用状态
   - `enableTimeStamps()`: 成功启用/禁用时间戳

4. **撤销功能**：
   - `isUndoEnabled()`: 返回撤销启用状态
   - `enableUndo()`: 成功启用撤销功能
   - `setCp()`: 成功设置检查点
   - `getCpID()`: 返回检查点ID
   - `getNumUndoRecsOnCp()`: 返回检查点上的撤销记录数

5. **内存管理**：
   - `calcVMSize()`: 成功计算并返回虚拟内存使用量（字节）

6. **设计集合访问**：
   - `getAnalysisPoints()`: 返回分析点集合（可能为空）
   - `getConstraintGroups()`: 返回约束组集合（可能为空）
   - `getValues()`: 返回值集合（可能为空）

### 参数使用技巧

#### 1. 设计打开参数
- `aeOpenDesign()` 函数接受字符串参数，但需要设计已存在
- `emyDesign.openScratch()` 需要 `emyScalarName` 对象，创建这些对象需要正确处理命名空间
- 视图类型必须使用有效的保留视图类型：`maskLayout`, `schematic`, `schematicSymbol`, `netlist`, 或 `hierDesign`

#### 2. 错误处理
- 当设计不存在时，`aeOpenDesign()` 返回 `False` 而不是抛出异常
- 参数类型不匹配会导致详细的错误消息，显示可用的函数原型
- 使用 `try-except` 块处理可能的方法调用异常

#### 3. 库操作
- `dbCreateLib()` 成功创建库并返回库对象
- `dbOpenLib()` 成功打开现有库

### 常见错误和解决方法

#### 1. 设计打开失败
**问题**：`aeOpenDesign()` 返回 `False`
**原因**：设计不存在或权限不足
**解决**：确保设计存在，或使用写模式创建新设计

#### 2. 参数类型错误
**问题**：`Wrong number or type of arguments for overloaded function`
**原因**：参数类型不匹配，如传递字符串而不是 `emyScalarName`
**解决**：查看错误消息中的函数原型，使用正确的参数类型

#### 3. 抽象类实例化
**问题**：`No constructor defined - class is abstract`
**原因**：尝试实例化抽象类如 `emyNameSpace`
**解决**：查找正确的工厂方法或使用默认构造函数

#### 4. 视图类型无效
**问题**：`Invalid reservedViewType name`
**原因**：使用了无效的视图类型名称
**解决**：使用有效的保留视图类型常量

### 返回值分析

#### 布尔返回值
- `isScratch()`, `isModified()`, `isConsistent()` 等返回 `True`/`False`
- 表示设计状态的布尔属性

#### 整数返回值
- `getRefCount()`: 返回非负整数，表示设计引用计数
- `calcVMSize()`: 返回整数，表示虚拟内存使用量（字节）
- `getRevNumber()`: 返回整数，表示内部格式版本号

#### 集合返回值
- `getAnalysisPoints()`, `getConstraintGroups()` 等返回集合对象
- 可以使用 `len()` 获取元素数量
- 空集合表示设计中没有相应元素

#### 枚举/字符返回值
- `getMode()`: 返回字符表示设计模式
- `getUndoModel()`: 返回撤销模型枚举值

## 最佳实践

### 1. 设计打开流程
```python
import pyAether as pa

# 初始化环境
pa.emyInitAether("-adv")

# 打开库
lib = pa.dbOpenLib("TECHLIB", "r")

# 尝试打开设计
success = pa.aeOpenDesign(lib="TECHLIB", cell="cell_name", view="layout", mode="r")
if success:
    design = pa.aeGetCurDesign()
    # 使用设计对象
    # ...
    design.close()
```

### 2. 错误处理模式
```python
try:
    # 尝试操作
    result = design.someMethod()
except Exception as e:
    # 处理特定错误
    print(f"Error: {e}")
    # 回退或重试
```

### 3. 资源管理
```python
# 确保设计被正确关闭
design = None
try:
    design = pa.aeGetCurDesign()
    # 使用设计
    # ...
finally:
    if design:
        design.close()
```

### 4. 状态检查
```python
# 在执行操作前检查设计状态
if design.isModified():
    print("Design has unsaved changes")
    
if design.isScratch():
    print("This is a scratch design (cannot be saved directly)")
    
if not design.isConsistent():
    print("Design is inconsistent")
```

## 注意事项

### 1. 设计模式
- 设计可以处于不同模式：'r'（读）、'w'（写）、'a'（追加）、'A'（追加覆盖）、's' 或 'S'（临时）
- 临时设计（scratch）不能直接保存，需要使用 `saveAs()`

### 2. 引用计数
- 每个 `open()` 调用增加引用计数
- 每个 `close()` 调用减少引用计数
- 引用计数为0时，设计从内存中清除

### 3. 撤销系统
- 撤销功能需要显式启用：`enableUndo(True)`
- 检查点标记设计状态：`setCp()`
- 撤销模型影响撤销行为：`getEffectiveUndoModel()`

### 4. 时间戳
- 时间戳默认启用
- 可以禁用以提高性能：`enableTimeStamps(False)`
- 时间信息包括创建时间、最后保存时间和读取时间

### 5. 内存管理
- 大型设计可能消耗大量内存
- 使用 `calcVMSize()` 监控内存使用
- 使用 `minimizeVM()` 优化内存（性能影响）

## 测试代码执行情况

### 成功执行的测试
1. **静态方法测试**：`getRevNumber()`, `getOpenDesigns()`
2. **设计状态查询**：所有状态检查方法
3. **时间戳管理**：启用/禁用和查询
4. **撤销功能**：启用、检查点设置、状态查询
5. **内存管理**：虚拟内存计算
6. **设计集合访问**：获取各种集合

### 遇到的挑战
1. **设计创建/打开**：无法成功创建或打开设计进行完整测试
2. **参数类型**：`emyScalarName` 和 `emyNameSpace` 对象创建困难
3. **库设计访问**：TECHLIB 中的设计无法用测试的视图名称打开

### 建议的改进
1. 提供更详细的错误信息帮助调试设计打开问题
2. 简化 `emyScalarName` 和 `emyNameSpace` 的创建过程
3. 提供设计列表和视图枚举功能
4. 增强示例代码展示完整工作流程

## 结论

`emyDesign` 类提供了完整的设计管理功能，但需要正确处理参数类型和设计状态。测试表明核心功能正常工作，但设计创建和打开流程需要进一步探索。建议在实际使用前充分测试设计打开流程，并正确处理错误情况。

API 文档详细但需要实际示例来展示完整用法。对于生产使用，建议：
1. 建立设计打开/创建的可靠流程
2. 实现完整的错误处理
3. 监控设计状态和内存使用
4. 合理使用撤销和时间戳功能

  "api_descriptions": "Maps to the Python built-in types: `List[pyAether.emyPointF]`, `Tuple[pyAether.emyPointF]`\n\n---\n\n## 补充说明（通过测试验证）\n\n# vector1D_emyPointF API 详细描述\n\n## API 基本信息\n- **完整名称**: pyAether.vector1D_emyPointF\n- **API 名称**: vector1D_emyPointF\n- **API 类型**: Type (类型别名)\n- **API 分类**: 数据类型/容器类型\n\n## 功能描述\n`vector1D_emyPointF` 是 pyAether 库中定义的一个类型别名，用于表示 `emyPointF` 对象的一维向量（序列）。它映射到 Python 内置的 `List[pyAether.emyPointF]` 和 `Tuple[pyAether.emyPointF]` 类型。\n\n## 测试验证结果\n\n### 1. 基本功能验证\n通过测试代码验证了以下功能：\n\n#### 1.1 创建和操作\n```python\n# 创建 emyPointF 对象列表\npoint_list = [pyScript.emyPointF(1.0, 2.0), \n              pyScript.emyPointF(3.5, 4.5), \n              pyScript.emyPointF(5.0, 6.0)]\n\n# 创建 emyPointF 对象元组\npoint_tuple = (pyScript.emyPointF(1.0, 2.0),\n               pyScript.emyPointF(3.5, 4.5),\n               pyScript.emyPointF(5.0, 6.0))\n```\n\n#### 1.2 类型检查\n- `etListp(point_list)`: True (列表类型)\n- `etListp(point_tuple)`: True (元组类型)\n- `etVectorp(point_list)`: True (列表类型)\n- `etVectorp(point_tuple)`: False (etVectorp 只接受列表)\n\n#### 1.3 直接访问验证\n```python\nvector_type = getattr(pyScript, 'vector1D_emyPointF', None)\n# 输出: <class 'pyAether.pyaecmd.vector1D_emyPointF'>\n```\n\n### 2. 操作验证\n\n#### 2.1 基本操作\n- **迭代**: 支持标准的 Python 迭代\n- **索引访问**: 支持下标访问 `point_list[0]`\n- **切片**: 支持切片操作 `point_list[:2]`\n- **列表推导**: 支持列表推导式 `[p.x() for p in point_list]`\n- **修改元素**: 列表支持元素修改 `point_list[1] = new_point`\n\n#### 2.2 emyPointF 操作\nvector1D_emyPointF 中的每个元素都是 emyPointF 对象，支持以下操作：\n- `x()`, `y()`: 获取坐标\n- `distanceFrom2()`: 计算两点间距离的平方\n- `scale()`: 缩放坐标\n- `isCoordInt()`: 检查坐标是否为整数\n- `roundCoord()`: 坐标取整\n- `set()`: 设置坐标值\n\n### 3. 边界情况测试\n\n#### 3.1 空容器\n```python\nempty_list = []  # 空列表\nempty_tuple = ()  # 空元组\n```\n- `etListp(empty_list)`: True\n- `etListp(empty_tuple)`: True\n\n#### 3.2 单元素容器\n```python\nsingle_list = [pyScript.emyPointF(1.0, 1.0)]\nsingle_tuple = (pyScript.emyPointF(1.0, 1.0),)\n```\n\n#### 3.3 大型集合\n```python\nlarge_list = [pyScript.emyPointF(i, i*2) for i in range(100)]\n```\n可以成功创建包含 100 个元素的列表。\n\n## 最佳实践和常用场景\n\n### 1. 最佳实践\n1. **类型一致性**: 确保 vector1D_emyPointF 中只包含 emyPointF 对象，以保持类型安全。\n2. **性能考虑**: 对于大量点的操作，考虑使用列表推导式或生成器表达式。\n3. **内存管理**: 大型集合应考虑分块处理，避免一次性加载过多数据。\n\n### 2. 常用场景\n1. **几何图形处理**: 存储多边形顶点、路径点等。\n2. **坐标集合**: 存储一系列坐标点用于绘图或分析。\n3. **批量操作**: 对多个点执行相同的变换操作。\n4. **数据传递**: 在函数间传递点集合数据。\n\n## 参数使用的注意事项\n\n### 1. 参数类型\n- **输入参数**: 接受 `List[emyPointF]` 或 `Tuple[emyPointF]`\n- **元素类型**: 每个元素必须是 `emyPointF` 类型\n- **空容器**: 允许空列表或空元组\n\n### 2. 类型检查\n- 使用 `etListp()` 检查是否为列表或元组\n- 使用 `etVectorp()` 检查是否为列表（不接受元组）\n- 对于严格的类型检查，建议使用 `isinstance(obj, (list, tuple))` 并结合元素类型检查\n\n### 3. 常见错误\n1. **类型错误**: 尝试将非 emyPointF 对象添加到 vector1D_emyPointF\n2. **索引越界**: 访问不存在的索引\n3. **元组不可变**: 尝试修改元组中的元素（元组是不可变的）\n\n## 返回值的详细说明\n\n### 1. 返回值类型\n- vector1D_emyPointF 本身是一个类型别名，不直接返回值\n- 使用该类型的函数通常返回 `List[emyPointF]` 或 `Tuple[emyPointF]`\n\n### 2. 操作返回值\n1. **索引访问**: 返回 `emyPointF` 对象\n2. **切片操作**: 返回相同类型的子序列\n3. **迭代**: 每次迭代返回 `emyPointF` 对象\n\n### 3. 相关函数返回值\n- `etListp()`: 返回布尔值，表示对象是否为列表或元组\n- `etVectorp()`: 返回布尔值，表示对象是否为列表\n\n## 常见的错误和解决方法\n\n### 1. 错误类型: 类型不匹配\n**错误示例**:\n```python\n# 错误: 混合类型\nmixed_list = [pyScript.emyPointF(1, 2), \"string\", 123]\n```\n\n**解决方法**:\n```python\n# 正确: 统一类型\npoint_list = [pyScript.emyPointF(1, 2), \n              pyScript.emyPointF(3, 4), \n              pyScript.emyPointF(5, 6)]\n```\n\n### 2. 错误类型: 元组不可变\n**错误示例**:\n```python\npoint_tuple = (pyScript.emyPointF(1, 2), pyScript.emyPointF(3, 4))\npoint_tuple[0] = pyScript.emyPointF(5, 6)  # TypeError\n```\n\n**解决方法**:\n```python\n# 如果需要修改，使用列表\npoint_list = [pyScript.emyPointF(1, 2), pyScript.emyPointF(3, 4)]\npoint_list[0] = pyScript.emyPointF(5, 6)  # 正确\n```\n\n### 3. 错误类型: 无效操作\n**错误示例**:\n```python\npoint = pyScript.emyPointF(1, 2)\nresult = point[0]  # TypeError: 'emyPointF' object is not subscriptable\n```\n\n**解决方法**:\n```python\npoint = pyScript.emyPointF(1, 2)\nx = point.x()  # 正确: 使用 x() 方法\ny = point.y()  # 正确: 使用 y() 方法\n```\n\n### 4. 性能优化建议\n1. **避免频繁创建**: 对于大量点操作，考虑重用对象\n2. **使用适当的数据结构**: 根据访问模式选择列表（可变）或元组（不可变）\n3. **批量操作**: 使用向量化操作而不是循环\n\n## 与其他 vector1D 类型的关系\n\npyAether 提供了多种 vector1D 类型，用于不同类型的一维向量：\n- `vector1D_emyPointF`: emyPointF 对象的一维向量\n- `vector1D_int`: 整数的一维向量\n- `vector1D_double`: 双精度浮点数的一维向量\n- `vector1D_emyString`: 字符串的一维向量\n- `vector1D_bool`: 布尔值的一维向量\n\n这些类型遵循相同的模式，都是对应 Python 内置类型的类型别名。\n\n## 使用示例\n\n### 示例 1: 创建和操作点列表\n```python\nimport pyAether as pyScript\n\n# 创建点列表\npoints = [pyScript.emyPointF(x, x*2) for x in range(10)]\n\n# 计算所有点的 x 坐标总和\nx_sum = sum(p.x() for p in points)\n\n# 缩放所有点\nfor point in points:\n    point.scale(2.0)\n\n# 检查点坐标是否为整数\nint_points = [p for p in points if p.isCoordInt()]\n```\n\n### 示例 2: 几何计算\n```python\nimport pyAether as pyScript\nimport math\n\n# 创建多边形顶点\npolygon = [\n    pyScript.emyPointF(0, 0),\n    pyScript.emyPointF(10, 0),\n    pyScript.emyPointF(10, 10),\n    pyScript.emyPointF(0, 10)\n]\n\n# 计算多边形周长\nperimeter = 0\nfor i in range(len(polygon)):\n    p1 = polygon[i]\n    p2 = polygon[(i + 1) % len(polygon)]\n    distance = math.sqrt(p1.distanceFrom2(p2))\n    perimeter += distance\n```\n\n### 示例 3: 类型安全的函数\n```python\nimport pyAether as pyScript\n\ndef process_points(points):\n    \"\"\"\n    处理 emyPointF 点列表\n    \n    Args:\n        points: vector1D_emyPointF (List[emyPointF] 或 Tuple[emyPointF])\n    \n    Returns:\n        List[emyPointF]: 处理后的点列表\n    \"\"\"\n    if not pyScript.etListp(points):\n        raise TypeError(\"points must be a list or tuple\")\n    \n    # 处理每个点\n    result = []\n    for point in points:\n        if not isinstance(point, pyScript.emyPointF):\n            raise TypeError(f\"Expected emyPointF, got {type(point)}\")\n        \n        # 执行某些操作\n        processed = pyScript.emyPointF(point.x() * 2, point.y() * 2)\n        result.append(processed)\n    \n    return result\n```\n\n## 总结\n\n`vector1D_emyPointF` 是 pyAether 中用于处理 emyPointF 对象序列的重要类型别名。它提供了类型安全的方式来处理点集合，同时保持了 Python 列表和元组的灵活性和易用性。\n\n**关键要点**:\n1. 它是 `List[emyPointF]` 和 `Tuple[emyPointF]` 的类型别名\n2. 支持所有标准的 Python 序列操作\n3. 与 `etListp()` 和 `etVectorp()` 函数兼容\n4. 在几何计算、图形处理和批量操作中非常有用\n5. 需要确保类型一致性以避免运行时错误\n\n通过合理使用 vector1D_emyPointF，可以编写出既类型安全又高效的 pyAether 代码。\n"

输出: False\n\n# 检查设计\npyScript.dbCheckDesign(design)\n\n# 再次检查设计状态 - 应该返回True，因为设计已通过检查\nis_latest = pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)\nprint(f\"设计是否最新（检查后）: {is_latest}\") # 输出: True\n```\n\n### 完整工作流程\n```python\nimport pyAether as pyScript\n\n# 初始化查询环境\npyScript.emyInitQuery()\n\n# 创建库和设计\nlib_name = \"my_library\"\ncell_name = \"my_cell\"\nview_name = \"schematic\"\n\n# 创建库\nlib = pyScript.dbCreateLib(lib=lib_name)\n\n# 创建设计\ndesign = pyScript.dbNewCV(lib_name, cell_name, view_name)\n\n# 1. 初始状态检查\nprint(f\"初始状态是否最新: {pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)}\") # 可能为False\n\n# 2. 修改设计\nmaster = pyScript.dbNewCV(lib_name, \"master_cell\", \"symbol\")\ninstance = pyScript.dbCrtInst(design, (10, 10), master=master)\nprint(f\"添加实例后是否最新: {pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)}\") # 应该为False\n\n# 3. 检查设计\ncheck_result = pyScript.dbCheckDesign(design)\nprint(f\"设计检查结果: {check_result}\")\n\n# 4. 检查最新状态\nprint(f\"设计检查后是否最新: {pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)}\") # 应该为True\n\n# 5. 保存设计\nsave_result = pyScript.dbSaveCV(design)\nprint(f\"设计保存结果: {save_result}\")\nprint(f\"保存后是否最新: {pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)}\") # 应该保持为True\n```\n\n## 最佳实践和常用场景\n\n### 最佳实践\n1. **状态管理**: 在修改设计后，总是检查设计是否为最新状态\n2. **错误处理**: 检查 `dbCheckDesign` 的返回值，确保设计检查成功\n3. **资源清理**: 使用后适当关闭或释放设计资源\n\n### 常用场景\n1. **设计验证流程**: 在设计修改后，使用 `dbIsLatestCheck` 确认是否需要重新检查设计\n2. **自动化脚本**: 在自动化设计流程中，监控设计状态变化\n3. **版本控制**: 跟踪设计是否已被修改但未检查\n\n## 参数使用注意事项\n\n### 设计对象有效性\n- 确保传入的设计对象是有效的，否则函数可能抛出异常\n- 使用 `dbOpenCV` 或 `dbNewCV` 获取有效的设计对象\n- 检查设计对象是否为 `None` 或 `0`（表示无效）\n\n### 设计状态管理\n- 设计被修改后（如添加实例、修改属性等），`dbIsLatestCheck` 会返回 `False`\n- 只有成功调用 `dbCheckDesign` 后，设计才会被标记为最新状态\n- 保存设计（`dbSaveCV`）不会自动将设计标记为最新，仍需调用 `dbCheckDesign`\n\n## 返回值详细说明\n\n### True 的情况\n- 设计自上次检查以来未被修改\n- 设计已成功通过 `dbCheckDesign` 检查\n- 设计处于稳定、已验证的状态\n\n### False 的情况\n- 设计已被修改但未检查\n- 设计检查失败\n- 设计对象无效或不存在\n\n### 特殊情况\n- 传入 `None` 作为参数时，函数返回 `False`（测试观察结果）\n- 传入无效的设计对象标识符（如0）时，函数抛出 `TypeError`\n\n## 常见错误和解决方法\n\n### 错误1: TypeError: in method 'dbIsLatestCheck', argument 1 of type 'emyDesign *'\n- **原因**: 传入了无效的设计对象（如整数0）\n- **解决方法**: \n ```python\n # {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{ "api_name": "pyAether.dbIsLatestCheck", "api_type": "function", "api_descriptions": "# dbIsLatestCheck\n\n`dbIsLatestCheck`(*pDesign*)\n**`dbIsLatestCheck(pDesign: emyDesign) -\\> bool`**\n\nChecks whether the current status is the latest.\n\nParameters\n**pDesign**emyDesign\nThe design object.\n\nReturns\n**out**bool\nReturns True if the current status is the latest. Otherwise, returns False.\n\nExamples\n\n >>> import pyAether as pyScript\n >>> design = pyScript.dbOpenCV(\"test_adv\", \"test\", \"schematic\")\n >>> master = pyScript.dbNewCV(\"test_adv\", \"test1\", \"symbol\")\n >>> pyScript.dbCrtInst(design, (0, 1), master=master)\n >>> pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)\n False\n >>> pyScript.dbCheckDesign(design)\n >>> pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)\n True\n\n---\n\n## 补充说明（通过测试验证）\n\n# dbIsLatestCheck API 丰富描述\n\n## API 基本信息\n- **完整名称**: pyAether.dbIsLatestCheck\n- **API 名称**: dbIsLatestCheck\n- **API 类型**: Function\n- **API 分类**: Db Commands / Verify Database Commands\n\n## 功能描述\n`dbIsLatestCheck` 函数用于检查设计对象的当前状态是否为最新状态。当设计被修改后，该函数会返回 `False`，表示设计已不是最新状态。调用 `dbCheckDesign` 成功检查设计后，该函数会返回 `True`，表示设计已更新为最新状态。\n\n## 参数说明\n\n### pDesign: emyDesign\n- **类型**: emyDesign（设计对象标识符）\n- **描述**: 需要检查状态的设计对象\n- **注意事项**:\n - 必须是一个有效的设计对象标识符\n - 如果传入无效的设计对象（如0或None），函数会抛出异常或返回False\n - 设计对象可以通过 `dbOpenCV`、`dbNewCV` 等函数获取\n\n## 返回值说明\n\n### out: bool\n- **返回类型**: 布尔值\n- **返回值含义**:\n - `True`: 设计对象的当前状态是最新的\n - `False`: 设计对象的当前状态不是最新的（已被修改）\n\n## 使用示例\n\n### 基本用法\n```python\nimport pyAether as pyScript\n\n# 打开或创建设计\ndesign = pyScript.dbOpenCV(\"test_lib\", \"test_cell\", \"schematic\")\nif design is None:\n design = pyScript.dbNewCV(\"test_lib\", \"test_cell\", \"schematic\")\n\n# 创建设计的主单元\nmaster = pyScript.dbNewCV(\"test_lib\", \"master_cell\", \"symbol\")\n\n# 在设计中添加实例（修改设计）\npyScript.dbCrtInst(design, (0, 1), master=master)\n\n# 检查设计状态 - 应该返回False，因为设计已被修改\nis_latest = pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)\nprint(f\"设计是否最新（修改后）: {is_latest}\") # 输出: False\n\n# 检查设计\npyScript.dbCheckDesign(design)\n\n# 再次检查设计状态 - 应该返回True，因为设计已通过检查\nis_latest = pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)\nprint(f\"设计是否最新（检查后）: {is_latest}\") # 输出: True\n```\n\n### 完整工作流程\n```python\nimport pyAether as pyScript\n\n# 初始化查询环境\npyScript.emyInitQuery()\n\n# 创建库和设计\nlib_name = \"my_library\"\ncell_name = \"my_cell\"\nview_name = \"schematic\"\n\n# 创建库\nlib = pyScript.dbCreateLib(lib=lib_name)\n\n# 创建设计\ndesign = pyScript.dbNewCV(lib_name, cell_name, view_name)\n\n# 1. 初始状态检查\nprint(f\"初始状态是否最新: {pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)}\") # 可能为False\n\n# 2. 修改设计\nmaster = pyScript.dbNewCV(lib_name, \"master_cell\", \"symbol\")\ninstance = pyScript.dbCrtInst(design, (10, 10), master=master)\nprint(f\"添加实例后是否最新: {pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)}\") # 应该为False\n\n# 3. 检查设计\ncheck_result = pyScript.dbCheckDesign(design)\nprint(f\"设计检查结果: {check_result}\")\n\n# 4. 检查最新状态\nprint(f\"设计检查后是否最新: {pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)}\") # 应该为True\n\n# 5. 保存设计\nsave_result = pyScript.dbSaveCV(design)\nprint(f\"设计保存结果: {save_result}\")\nprint(f\"保存后是否最新: {pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)}\") # 应该保持为True\n```\n\n## 最佳实践和常用场景\n\n### 最佳实践\n1. **状态管理**: 在修改设计后，总是检查设计是否为最新状态\n2. **错误处理**: 检查 `dbCheckDesign` 的返回值，确保设计检查成功\n3. **资源清理**: 使用后适当关闭或释放设计资源\n\n### 常用场景\n1. **设计验证流程**: 在设计修改后，使用 `dbIsLatestCheck` 确认是否需要重新检查设计\n2. **自动化脚本**: 在自动化设计流程中，监控设计状态变化\n3. **版本控制**: 跟踪设计是否已被修改但未检查\n\n## 参数使用注意事项\n\n### 设计对象有效性\n- 确保传入的设计对象是有效的，否则函数可能抛出异常\n- 使用 `dbOpenCV` 或 `dbNewCV` 获取有效的设计对象\n- 检查设计对象是否为 `None` 或 `0`（表示无效）\n\n### 设计状态管理\n- 设计被修改后（如添加实例、修改属性等），`dbIsLatestCheck` 会返回 `False`\n- 只有成功调用 `dbCheckDesign` 后，设计才会被标记为最新状态\n- 保存设计（`dbSaveCV`）不会自动将设计标记为最新，仍需调用 `dbCheckDesign`\n\n## 返回值详细说明\n\n### True 的情况\n- 设计自上次检查以来未被修改\n- 设计已成功通过 `dbCheckDesign` 检查\n- 设计处于稳定、已验证的状态\n\n### False 的情况\n- 设计已被修改但未检查\n- 设计检查失败\n- 设计对象无效或不存在\n\n### 特殊情况\n- 传入 `None` 作为参数时，函数返回 `False`（测试观察结果）\n- 传入无效的设计对象标识符（如0）时，函数抛出 `TypeError`\n\n## 常见错误和解决方法\n\n### 错误1: TypeError: in method 'dbIsLatestCheck', argument 1 of type 'emyDesign *'\n- **原因**: 传入了无效的设计对象（如整数0）\n- **解决方法**: \n ```python\n # 错误示例\n # result = pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(0) # 会抛出TypeError\n \n # 正确示例\n design = pyScript.dbOpenCV(\"lib\", \"cell\", \"view\")\n if design is not None:\n result = pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)\n ```\n\n### 错误2: 设计始终返回False\n- **可能原因**:\n 1. 设计检查失败（`dbCheckDesign` 返回 `False`）\n 2. 设计存在验证错误\n 3. 缺少必要的技术库\n- **解决方法**:\n ```python\n # 检查设计验证结果\n check_result = pyScript.dbCheckDesign(design)\n if check_result:\n is_latest = pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)\n print(f\"设计是否最新: {is_latest}\")\n else:\n print(\"设计检查失败，需要修复设计错误\")\n \n # 使用 dbSeCheckDesign 获取详细错误信息\n errors = pyScript.dbSeCheckDesign(design)\n if errors:\n print(f\"设计错误: {errors}\")\n ```\n\n### 错误3: 设计检查成功但状态未更新\n- **可能原因**: 设计检查成功但状态未正确更新\n- **解决方法**: 确保按正确顺序调用API\n ```python\n # 正确顺序\n pyScript.dbCrtInst(design, point, master=master) # 修改设计\n print(pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)) # 应该返回False\n \n pyScript.dbCheckDesign(design) # 检查设计\n print(pyScript.dbIsLatestCheck(design)) # 应该返回True\n ```\n\n## 测试经验总结\n\n### 参数使用技巧\n1. **设计对象获取**: 使用 `dbOpenCV` 打开现有设计或 `dbNewCV` 创建新设计\n2. **状态验证**: 在关键设计操作前后检查 `dbIsLatestCheck` 的返回值\n3. **错误预防**: 始终验证设计对象的有效性\n\n### 返回值分析\n1. **一致性**: 在测试环境中，函数行为与文档描述一致\n2. **可预测性**: 修改设计后返回 `False`，成功检查后返回 `True`\n3. **错误处理**: 对无效输入有明确的错误响应\n\n### 常见错误\n1. **无效设计对象**: 传入0会抛出 `TypeError`\n2. **设计检查失败**: `dbCheckDesign` 返回 `False` 时，`dbIsLatestCheck` 保持 `False`\n3. **状态同步**: 需要显式调用 `dbCheckDesign` 来更新状态\n\n### 测试代码执行情况\n测试代码在 `run_pyAether_code_tool` 工具中执行成功，验证了以下行为：\n1. ✅ 修改设计后，`dbIsLatestCheck` 返回 `False`\n2. ✅ 调用 `dbCheckDesign` 后，`dbIsLatestCheck` 返回 `True`\n3. ✅ 对无效参数（0）抛出 `TypeError`\n4. ✅ 对 `None` 参数返回 `False`\n5. ✅ 与文档示例行为一致\n\n## 相关API\n- `dbCheckDesign`: 检查设计，成功检查后会将设计标记为最新状态\n- `dbCheckAndSaveDesign`: 检查并保存设计\n- `dbSaveCV`: 保存设计单元视图\n- `dbOpenCV`: 打开设计单元视图\n- `dbNewCV`: 创建新的设计单元视图\n- `dbCrtInst`: 在设计单元中创建实例\n\n## 注意事项\n1. **设计检查必要性**: 只有成功调用 `dbCheckDesign` 后，设计才会被标记为最新\n2. **状态持久性**: 设计状态在会话中保持，关闭设计后状态会重置\n3. **性能考虑**: 频繁调用 `dbIsLatestCheck` 对性能影响较小，但设计检查可能较耗时\n4. **错误处理**: 始终检查 `dbCheckDesign` 的返回值，确保设计检查成功\n\n## 版本兼容性\n- 该API在 pyAether 2025.06.sp3 版本中测试通过\n- 与早期版本保持向后兼容性\n- 建议在使用前验证API在特定版本中的行为\n", "category": "Db Commands / Verify Database Commands" }"},{"type":"text","text":"{ "api_name": "pyAether.dbCheckAndSaveDesign", "api_type": "function", "api_descriptions": "# dbCheckAndSaveDesign\n\n`dbCheckAndSaveDesign`(*\\*args*, *\\*\\*kwargs*)\n**`dbCheckAndSaveDesign(cv: emyDesign, fileName: emyString = “”) -\\> bool`**\n\nThis command is used to check and save the design.\n\nParameters\n**cv**emyDesign\nIt specifies the cell view id.\n\n**filename**emyString\nIt specifies the file in which to write the report content.
